title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent tasks or RL environments Terms US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

title: Client Success Manager - Academia (m/f/x)
description: At Statista , we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions. Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees. We value and celebrate our diverse culture. Are you ready to join us? Your role As part of the Client Success team, you will manage your own portfolio of academic and public-sector clients across EMEA together with a Sales Manager. In times of change, reliable data becomes increasingly important. You will help clients navigate these changes as a strategic advisor, demonstrating the value Statista brings to teaching, learning, and research. You will find creative ways to engage universities and public-sector organizations, understand their evolving needs, and help them get lasting value from our products. You identify opportunities to grow existing accounts and keep a clear focus on your portfolio’s revenue targets. Together with the Sales Manager, you develop strategies that strengthen client relationships and support long-term growth. Your profile You hold a university degree in social sciences, business management, or a related field, at either the bachelor’s or master’s level. You have more than 3 years of experience in B2B client relationship management, ideally in the education and/or public sector. Excellent English skills are a priority, knowledge of French or Italian is a plus. You are confident in public speaking and delivering engaging workshops, trainings and presentations. You have a hands-on mindset and the ability to work independently, proactively, and take ownership. You bring strong team spirit and enthusiasm for working in an international environment. You've developed an affinity for AI and workflow optimisation through new tools. You have strong MS Office skills; experience with Salesforce is a plus. What we offer In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from: Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year Hybrid work and flex-time International team and social events Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities Career & training opportunities Attractive locations and modern offices Mental health support with OpenUp Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above. title: Elektronik-Ingenieur
description: About pplwise pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics. About our client: Filics Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will design the electronics at the core of the next generation of robots. About the role This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly. Filics doesn’t just use off-the-shelf components. It builds its own custom IP. The robots run on advanced boards that cover a wide range of electrical engineering. On one end is high power, such as battery and motor controllers. On the other end are high-speed interfaces like PCIe, USB and MIPI CSI. The real challenge is making all these subsystems work together as one system. Many of these problems have no textbook solution. Solving them takes solid experience, a deep understanding of the physics and a creative mind. The EE team is small, and the robot is far from finished. You’ll own your boards end to end : requirements, system design, schematic, layout, design review, sourcing, manufacturing, testing and validation. You’ll keep owning them for as long as they’re in production. You’ll work closely with Embedded Software, Mechanical Engineering, Software and the Production team. As Filics moves from prototypes to series production, your designs need to work reliably at scale , not just in the lab. What you’ll do Take full ownership of a complex PCB project and get it running in as few revisions as possible Design high-power and high-speed circuits and make sure they work together at system level Design for EMC, manufacturability and testability, and take boards through EMC testing and certification Bring new technical approaches to the team, for example a new converter architecture that enables higher charging power in a smaller package Introduce useful processes from your experience, such as simulation workflows that validate a layout before it goes to production Help with board bring-up and debugging together with Embedded Software, and support Production with clear documentation and training Take over ownership of existing boards so the team shares responsibility About you Several years designing electronics in an R&D environment at a smaller hardware company driven by innovation (e.g. robotics, e-mobility, aviation, autonomous vehicles, motion control) A proven record of taking PCBs within a larger system from requirements to a validated product Strong skills in schematic design and PCB layout (Altium, KiCad, OrCAD or similar) Hands-on debugging experience with an oscilloscope, logic analyzer, VNA or spectrum analyzer, plus soldering Experience with designs that went through EMC testing or CE certification An innovator’s mindset: you have built something new or significantly improved an existing concept Basic simulation know-how (e.g. LTspice, ANSYS, thermal/EM/tolerance analysis); deeper experience is a strong plus Basic experience with Linux and embedded software You work independently, take ownership and thrive without rigid structures What Filics offers Real ownership of your designs, from first draft to series production Space to innovate and a wide range of technical challenges, from power electronics to high-speed design A small, high-caliber team with close collaboration across disciplines Fast growth: one year at Filics teaches you what usually takes many years at a large company An on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to Engineering and Assembly Sound like you? title: Robot Learning Engineer
description: Why this role is exciting Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers buy their groceries from us through Rohlik.cz , Knuspr.de , Kifli.hu , Gurkerl.at and Sezamo.ro , choosing from over 17,000 items, delivered within a couple of hours in 15-minute windows. We are building the autonomous grocer. Maia, our AI assistant, already talks to customers and builds their orders; agents are moving into our buying and logistics; vision models are learning to watch quality. The next frontier is physical: robots taking over more and more of the work in our fulfilment centres, until fresh food moves from producers to households at a cost nobody else can match. We are setting out to record how our own people handle groceries and to turn those recordings into a training corpus for manipulation policies. Our warehouses already log what happened on every pick and every quality check, so the recordings can carry labels most datasets never get. Making that hold is part of the job. You decide what makes an hour of footage trainable — before we bank hundreds of them. What you will own and deliver The capture spec. Cameras, mounts, calibration, and what disqualifies an episode. You write it before we buy the fleet and enforce it after. When the spec and the floor disagree, you go to the floor and find out which one is wrong. Ground truth. Hand pose is the signal that transfers from human video to robot policies, and warehouse reality — work gloves, occlusion, cold halls — is exactly where the published models struggle. You own how we measure that and how we close the gap. The evaluation harness. The corpus only counts if a policy can train on it. You build the harness that decides which hours make the bank, and you hold the trainability bar as the volume grows. The first training runs. Once hours bank, you post-train open robot-learning models on our data and run the first task evaluations. Judgment before spend. The field moves monthly. You read what is published, reproduce the claims we depend on, and steer our capture before the money is spent, not after. The scope This is a seat on a small, newly created team: an operations lead who runs capture on the floor, a data engineer who owns the pipeline, and you: the machine-learning voice in the room. This is not a research-scientist role, and no publication record is required. The job is to make a corpus trainable and to train the first policies on it. What we are looking for PyTorch, and computer vision with real 3D geometry. Camera calibration, pose estimation, SLAM fundamentals. You have debugged an extrinsic calibration at least once in your life and know why it drifted. You can read a paper and reproduce it. Our pipeline is assembled from published work, and your job is knowing which claims survive contact with a chilled warehouse hall. You know what policies train on. Familiar with the current robot-learning stack and policy classes well enough to know what the training side will demand of the data before the data exists. Dataset instincts. You have trained on data you collected yourself, and you know the failure modes that only show up at training tim.. Comfortable as the only ML voice. You make the call, write it down, and revisit it when the pilot data says otherwise. AI is how work gets done here. Our engineers use Claude Code and Devin daily, and we expect you to direct agents for the unglamorous parts — harness code, data plumbing, reproduction scripts — while keeping the quality bar exactly where it was. Particularly relevant. Hand-pose estimation or egocentric video in production; multi-camera rigs and time sync; experience post-training robot-learning models; ROS 2. What success looks like in 90 days You have written the capture spec and we set up the first rigs against it. Your pilot gates have numbers, the first hours have passed your harness, and you can tell the people who sign the budget, with data, what the next hundred hours should look like. Are we a good fit? Take this role if you would rather own the spec that decides whether a dataset becomes an asset or a write-off than tune someone else's model on someone else's data, if a fulfilment centre at 6 a.m. sounds like a lab to you, and if you want the shortest possible line between your technical judgment and a capital decision. Read our culture code and are we a good fit? . What we offer The physical-AI side of the autonomous grocer, with the capture spec and the first training runs yours from day one A data asset few teams in the world get to build, in fresh groceries, a domain as hard as manipulation gets Off-the-shelf hardware, a managed cloud estate, and a mandate that has already started Benefits — see what we offer Are you in? Instead of a cover letter: pick a published human-video-to-robot-policy pipeline you rate, and tell us where it breaks on a warehouse floor where every hand wears a work glove. #LI-ML1 Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior DevOps/ Cloud Engineer (f/m/d)
description: Become a Part of ACCURIDS Join us and help shape the future of pharmaceutical data! At ACCURIDS, we’re building the data backbone behind life-science innovation — a system that identifies, links, and standardizes critical enterprise data in compliance with global standards such as ISO IDMP. We help global life-science companies launch products faster, more safely, and with better patient outcomes. At ACCURIDS, you’ll join a collaborative, growth-driven environment where your work makes a real impact from day one. How you’ll make an impact: You set up, maintain, and troubleshoot customer installations , managing both high-standard SaaS environments and restrictive customer on-premise deployments. You operate and scale our core AWS infrastructure , managing multi-account environments, EKS, RDS, S3, networking, and IAM. You support our development team with product operations , maintaining and extending GitLab CI/CD pipelines, driving declarative GitOps workflows (ArgoCD/Kargo), and managing incident response. You develop the Accurids SaaS platform stack , focusing on enhancing platform automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), identity management, and advanced observability. You drive our security operations , building out our compliance posture through log reviews, vulnerability scanning, active monitoring, alerting, and supporting ISO 27001 requirements. You ensure operational resilience and continuity , working as a key senior pillar to transition our infrastructure from a single-point-of-failure risk to a robust, well-documented architecture. What helps you succeed: Adaptability & Continuous Learning: A strong engineering mindset with a proven ability to pick up new tools, architectures, and methodologies rapidly as our ecosystem evolves. Cloud & Infrastructure Foundation: 3–5+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Platform Engineering, with production exposure to a major cloud provider (we use AWS, but Azure or GCP experience is just as welcome). Containerization Concepts: Solid foundational knowledge of the Kubernetes ecosystem, Docker containerization, and configuring CI/CD pipelines (such as GitLab CI). Modern Operations (Our Stack): Familiarity with—or a strong desire to learn—Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and declarative GitOps workflows (ArgoCD/Kargo). Observability & Security Awareness: Observability & Security: Familiarity with cloud security tooling and monitoring/observability (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Elasticsearch). Experience building a security posture is a strong plus. Core Competencies: Business fluency in English and an openness to integrating AI-assisted tools (like Cursor, Copilot, or ChatGPT) into your daily scripting and debugging workflows. (It’s a nice-to-have bonus if you have prior experience with Elasticsearch, Keycloak, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, or compliance frameworks like ISO 27001!) Why you’ll love working here: Impactful Career Growth: Evolve into a Lead DevOps / Platform Lead role or deepen your specialization in Cloud Infrastructure, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and DevSecOps as we scale. Epic Office & Hybrid Work: Work from our brand-new office in the KölnTurm, featuring breathtaking views over the city (even higher than the view from the Cologne Cathedral!). Enjoy flexible hybrid options. (Note: On-site presence in Cologne/NRW is required; fully remote work is not offered). Community & Industry Events: Connect and grow your network through exclusive industry events hosted regularly right in our scenic office space. Competitive Compensation: Fixed salary package of €75,000 – €100,000 per year for a full-time, permanent position. Work-Life Balance & Perks: 30 days of paid vacation, a personal learning budget, hardware of your choice (Mac, Linux, Windows), and your choice between a subsidized Urban Sports Club membership or a €50/month City Plus Card. Empowered Culture: High trust, flat hierarchies, and an environment where your decisions directly shape the product. Not ticking every box? We encourage you to apply anyway! We know great talent doesn’t always follow a checklist and we care more about your potential, curiosity, and motivation to learn. At ACCURIDS, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially encourage women and people from underrepresented backgrounds in tech, science, and data to apply. title: Head of Technology (m/w/d)
description: We find your position. ISA Telematics baut Systeme, die Menschen, Fahrzeuge und Güter im Blick behalten, wenn es darauf ankommt: Notruf, Ortung, Alarmierung. Das Besondere daran ist der Umfang. Die ganze Kette läuft durch eine Hand, von der Firmware auf dem Gerät über Funkprotokoll und Server bis zur Leitstelle. Kein Modul, kein Ausschnitt: das komplette System. Und die Probleme sind echt. GPS, das im Stahlbau aussteigt. Mobilfunk, der abbricht, wenn er gebraucht wird. Geräte, die jahrelang im Feld stehen und trotzdem aktualisierbar bleiben müssen. Ein Alarm, der nicht meistens ankommt, sondern immer. Unsere Kunden: Industrie, Energieversorger, Bahn und Logistik, Kliniken, Polizei- und Sicherheitsorganisationen im DACH-Raum. Das Produkt ist eingeführt, zertifiziert und profitabel, du baust also mit echten Nutzern und laufenden Umsätzen im Rücken. Why this role matters now

This role sits at the centre of our AI-led delivery transformation. We are rebuilding our digital evidence platform as AI-Native, with AI tooling acting as a daily partner from design through verification. The right architect is not someone with a long list of AI credentials - AI moves too fast for credentials to mean much. The right architect is someone who already uses AI in their daily work, has formed clear judgement about where it belongs and where it does not, and is curious enough to learn the next tool when their current one is superseded.

So, what’s the role all about?

We are looking for a talented Architect and Software Developer to join our team. You must:

  • Be able to communicate effectively, including via email, instant message, phone, and video conferencing tools.
  • Be fierce in your pursuit of product quality.
  • Be an excellent problem solver with an active interest in the latest design and development tools and technologies.
  • Be knowledgeable and enthusiastic about process.
  • Be practically fluent with AI tooling - using Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent in your daily work, not just experimentally. We will discuss specific examples at interview.
  • Be able to recognize opportunities for optimization and enhancement of process, product architecture and delivery based on the evolutions in AI.
  • Have clear judgement about where AI belongs in a public-safety platform, and where it does not.

How will you make an impact?

You will be responsible for:

  • Owning the architecture, and carrying out design, AI-led implementation and validation in Cloud-based, multi-threaded, multi-server environments -working in our AI-led delivery method where code, tests and decisions are AI-drafted, with you setting intent, orchestrating implementation, and validating outputs.
  • Leading technical decisions on architectural direction using a collaborative, team-based approach.
  • Ensuring the architecture takes into account the concerns of security, scalability, compatibility, maintainability — and the responsible, evidenced use of AI in both build-time and run-time.
  • Performing testing of your work, fixing defects, and helping to resolve customer support cases.
  • Ensuring that the team adheres to the architectural direction and standards.
  • Mentoring and coaching team members in architecture practices, AI-led delivery techniques, and the discipline of validating AI outputs.
  • Liaising with Product Management during planning sessions.

Have you got what it takes?

  • Solid experience developing applications in C# using Visual Studio/Visual Studio Code.
  • Proven track record of breaking down complex market requirements into secure, scalable and resilient system designs.
  • Experience with multi-tenant cloud solutions.
  • Experience working in collaborative multidisciplinary teams.
  • Experience creating maintainable code and using source control solutions such as DevOps, GIT or similar.
  • Experience of unit testing, code reviews, and other product quality disciplines.
  • Solid understanding of the principles of network security, authentication, and authorization.
  • Experience of working with databases using Entity Framework or similar.
  • Good knowledge of SOLID principles.
  • Experience creating RESTful APIs and ensuring API extensibility.
  • Recent practical experience using AI tooling (Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent) in your daily work, not just experimentation. Comfortable describing what worked, what did not, and what you decided.
  • Output discipline: you remain accountable for the architecture you are responsible for, whatever helped you produce it.
  • Comfort with probabilistic systems, and clear judgement about when to use AI in a high-trust domain.
  • Learning velocity: able to ramp on a new AI tool or technique in days, not months.

You will have an advantage if you also have:

  • Security best practice (OWASP top ten)
  • Azure SQL Server
  • DevOps, Pipelines, TeamCity, GitHub
  • Windows services
  • Experience using AI tooling specifically in the architect role - for design review, ADR drafting, threat modelling, contract design, or similar.
  • Familiarity with AI-Native software patterns (agentic workflows, evaluation harnesses, prompt-and-response evaluation, evidence packets).

What we do not require

We do not require you to be an AI expert. AI moves too fast for credentials to mean much. We require curiosity, recent practical use, output discipline, and the judgement to ship under accountability.

About the interview process

The final stage includes a working session using our AI tooling. The aim is to see how you think - how you set intent, validate outputs, and make decisions - not to test memorised knowledge.

title: Senior Compliance Lead, EMEA
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

The Cities team leads the work necessary to implement the regulatory products and processes needed globally to comply with regulations, and does so in a manner that also sustainably supports Airbnb's growth.

Within Cities, this role owns Airbnb's platform regulatory compliance program across EMEA — the growing set of EU and UK obligations that sit alongside, and increasingly beyond, short-term rental regulation.

The Difference You Will Make

As Senior Compliance Lead, EMEA, you are the accountable owner for a portfolio of platform regulations that is expanding in scope, scrutiny, and consequence — including the Digital Services Act, the UK Online Safety Act, and more.

You will translate each obligation into a durable operating process, a defensible reporting methodology, or a product change — and serve as a trusted advisor to Legal, Policy, and Product leadership on how Airbnb meets its regulatory commitments in the region.

A Typical Day: 

  • Own the EMEA compliance portfolio. Establish the operating processes and documentation that sustain obligations at scale, and report and monitor status and risk.
  • Deliver regulatory reporting and submissions. Own the annual and ad hoc reporting calendar end to end. Deliver against regulatory deadlines, and iterate so each cycle is faster and more defensible than the last.
  • Assess obligations and strengthen assurance. Identify new and changing obligations early, evaluate our readiness against them, and recommend the measures required to meet them. 
  • Translate regulatory requirements into scalable solutions. Define the product, engineering, and data requirements needed to meet obligations at scale, and partner with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap, sequence delivery, and validate outcomes against compliance standards.

Your Expertise: 

  • 12+ years of experience in regulatory compliance, compliance program management, or regulatory operations — preferably in a technology platform or another highly regulated industry.
  • Proven track record owning a multi-jurisdiction, cross-functional compliance program end to end, with direct experience across the Digital Services Act, and the UK Online Safety Act. 
  • Hands-on experience with a recurring regulator-facing reporting cycle and the relationship management that comes with it.
  • Track record partnering with Product and Engineering to deliver regulatory requirements into live products.

Building Models: Model building and validation, sales effects calculations, ROIs, media optimisation

  • Oversee the building of comprehensive base models according to the project specification, incorporating all drivers of KPIs, providing rationale for variables entered, understanding coefficients and SFX.

.Creation of presentations: Content creation, summary of findings, accuracy checks

  • Answer specific data questions that may arise in external meetings as the lead analyst; act as a specialist closest to the data.

Innovation: Process improvements, product development, new trainings

title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Training - UK
description: Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week Please note that eligibility may vary depending on your location, as some regions may not be supported by the client. Check out this Loom video for more details: https://www.loom.com/share/b0d1b0bf24c44ae8b95dca84b9db60e5 We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code. This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer. What this role actually is You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on: • Whether the response makes sense • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part. What you'll be doing • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end • Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code • Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4) • Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading • Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code What we mean by "taste" We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like: • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say? • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct? • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output? • Would this interaction build or erode trust? You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly. Who you are • Senior, Staff or Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience) • Strong background in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python • Hands-on experience with at least one of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor • Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows • Able to evaluate code without executing it or reviewing every line • Strong written and spoken English (B2 or above). You'll be writing detailed feedback and recording short video explanations, so this is a hard requirement • Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback • High bar for what good engineering looks like Nice to have • Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows • Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards Engagement details • Rate: $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location • Hours: 10-20 hours/week, flexible • Duration: ongoing. Projects run from about two weeks to a few months each, and we offer new ones to evaluators who do well • Start: as soon as you clear the take-home and a project has an open seat • Process: one take-home evaluation exercise with a recorded Loom walkthrough. title: Senior Specialist, QA
description:
About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

  • HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

  • HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

  • HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

  • HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Overview of Role: 

The Senior Specialist, QA will provide operational leadership and quality oversight for the review, approval and release-readiness of clinical and commercial product batches. 

The role is responsible for ensuring that batch documentation is complete, accurate, traceable, and compliant with applicable GMP requirements, approved procedures and regulatory commitments before submission to QA for final disposition or QP certification. The person will coordinate batch-release activities across Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs and external manufacturing partners, ensuring that issues are identified, escalated and resolved in a timely manner. The position will also lead process improvements, support inspection readiness and promote high standards of data integrity and Good Documentation Practice across the batch-release process. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Batch Review and Release Readiness 
  • Coordinate the end-to-end QA review of executed batch manufacturing, packaging, testing and release documentation for IMP and Commercial biological batch records. 
  • Coordinate the preparation and collation of batch documentation required for final batch disposition or QP certification from internal and external sources. 
  • Verify that batch records are complete, accurate, and compliant with approved procedures, specifications and applicable GMP requirements. 
  • Confirm that relevant deviations, investigations, change controls, CAPAs, and laboratory results have been appropriately assessed and approved before release. 
  • Identify documentation gaps, discrepancies and potential compliance risks, and coordinate their timely resolution. 
  • Maintain oversight of batch-release priorities, review status, outstanding actions, and planned release dates. 
  • Escalate critical issues or potential delays to Quality leadership and relevant stakeholders. 
  • Ensure that batch-release documentation is appropriately archived and readily retrievable electronically. 

 

  • Quality Systems and Compliance: 
  • Ensure batch-release activities are performed in accordance with current GMP, Good Documentation Practice, data-integrity principles, and internal procedures. 
  • Support the effective operation of quality systems associated with deviations, CAPAs, change controls, document control, and training. 
  • Review and approve relevant quality documents, including SOPs, work instructions, forms, checklists, and batch-release procedures. 
  • Maintain controlled documentation and ensure that current approved versions are available to relevant personnel. 
  • Support periodic reviews of procedures and identify opportunities to strengthen compliance and operational effectiveness. 
  • Promote the appropriate use of electronic quality and document management systems. 
  • Act as a subject-matter expert for batch documentation, release-readiness and associated document-control processes for all batch release activities. 
  • Internal Team Coordination (EU QA) 
  • Provide day-to-day leadership and technical guidance to QA batch reviewers and supporting personnel. 
  • Plan and allocate batch-review activities according to business priorities, product demand, and release timelines. 
  • Monitor team workload, quality metrics, and completion of assigned activities. 
  • Develop and deliver training in Good Documentation Practice, batch-record review and relevant quality-system processes. 
  • Support onboarding and qualifications of new QA team members. 
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and continuous-improvement culture within the QA function. 

 

  • External Team Collaboration: 
  • Work closely with Manufacturing, Quality Control / CMC, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Supply and other relevant functions to support timely batch release. 
  • Coordinate with all Summit CMOs, testing laboratories and service providers to obtain missing documents and resolve release-related queries. 
  • Communicate batch status, risks, priorities and outstanding actions clearly to internal and external stakeholders. 
  • Support changes affecting batch documentation or release processes. 
  • Participate in cross-functional meetings concerning batch disposition, documentation, readiness, and supply continuity internally. 

 

  • Inspection Readiness and Continuous Improvement 
  • Maintain batch-release processes and supporting records in a continuous state of inspection of readiness. 
  • Support regulatory inspections, customer audits, internal audits, and supplier audits. 
  • Retrieve and present batch documentation and quality-system records during audits and inspections. 
  • Track batch-review metrics, recurring documentation issues, cycle times, and overdue actions. 
  • Analyse trends and recommend improvements to increase efficiency, right-first-time performance and compliance. 
  • Lead or contribute to Lean and process-optimization initiatives within the batch-release function. 
  • Support the implementation and enhancement of electronic quality, document management and reporting systems. 

Qualifications and Experience 

  • Essential 
  • Recognized qualification in Quality, Pharmaceutical Science, Life Sciences, Engineering or related discipline. 
  • Significant experience in Quality Assurance within a pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical or similarly regulated manufacturing environment – preferably in Biologic manufacturing, Packaging and Labelling environments.  
  • Practical experience reviewing executed batch records and supporting batch disposition or QP certification activities. 
  • Knowledge of GMP, Good Documentation Practice, and data-integrity requirements. 
  • Experience working with deviations, investigations, CAPAs, and change controls. 
  • Experience using electronic quality, document management and other enterprise-systems - systems such as MasterControl, NetSuite, Veeva Vault, TrackWise, SAP or equivalent platforms. 
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple priorities and deliver against critical release timelines. 
  • Experience supporting the release of medicinal products or investigational medicinal products. 
  • Experience working with contract manufacturing organizations and external testing laboratories 

 

  • Key Competencies 
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy 
  • Sound quality and compliance judgement 
  • Leadership and team coordination 
  • Effective prioritization and workload management 
  • Problem-solving and risk-based decision-making 
  • Clear communication and stakeholder management 
  • Audit and inspection readiness 
  • Data integrity and information governance 
  • Process improvement and operational efficiency 
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment

title: Managing Principal - Software Engineering & Architecture H/F
description:
Managing Principal - Software Engineering & Architecture H/F

Location: Paris (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent

 

Nous recherchons un(e) Managing Principal - Software Engineering & Architecture pour piloter et développer notre expertise en software engineering, tout en accompagnant nos clients dans leurs transformations les plus complexes.

Ce rôle de leadership technologique, s'articule autour de trois dimensions essentielles : Engineering Leadership, Architecture & Transformation et Client Development.

En tant que Software Engineering Chapter Lead, vous définirez les orientations techniques, renforcerez les standards d'ingénierie et accompagnerez le développement de notre communauté de Tech Leads, d'architectes et d'ingénieurs seniors.

Vous aurez une forte proximité avec les technologies et la réalisation des projets, tout en collaborant avec les décideurs de haut niveau chez nos clients afin de structurer leurs transformations, d'influencer leurs choix technologiques et de développer de nouvelles opportunités pour Capco.

 

Ce que vous ferez

Engineering & Chapter Leadership

  • Piloter et développer notre communauté software engineering en définissant les standards, les principes et les bonnes pratiques.
  • Accompagner, coacher et faire monter en compétences les tech leads, les architectes et les ingénieurs seniors, tout en contribuant au développement des expertises.
  • Promouvoir une culture d'excellence en ingénierie, de responsabilisation technique et d'amélioration continue.

Hands-on Architecture & Engineering

  • Apporter une expertise technique approfondie et opérationnelle sur les technologies backend, notamment Java
  • Analyser en profondeur les architectures et les conceptions techniques, challenger les choix technologiques et orienter les équipes vers des solutions pragmatiques.
  • Accompagner les initiatives de modernisation technologique autour des architectures cloud-native, des systèmes distribués, des API, des microservices et des architectures événementielles (event-driven).
  • Garantir que les solutions répondent aux exigences de sécurité, de scalabilité, de résilience, de performance et d'observabilité.

Client Advisory & Business Development

  • Développer des relations de confiance avec les CTO, CIO, Heads of Engineering, Heads of Architecture et responsables Product de nos clients.
  • Challenger les approches de manière constructive et influencer les décisions stratégiques de nos clients.
  • Contribuer à l'élaboration des propositions commerciales et aux soutenances, notamment en définissant les approches, les architectures, les équipes et les modèles de delivery.
  • Participer au développement des offres et du portefeuille clients de Capco dans les domaines du Software Engineering, de l'Architecture, du Cloud et de la modernisation technologique.

 

Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes un(e) leader expérimenté(e) en ingénierie logicielle et en technologie, capable de conjuguer une expertise technique approfondie, une vision architecturale, des compétences en leadership et une forte orientation client.

Votre parcours peut notamment vous avoir amené(e) à occuper des fonctions de Principal Engineer, Principal Tech Lead, Engineering Lead, Software Architect ou Head of Engineering.

Vous disposez des compétences et expériences suivantes :

  • Une expérience confirmée dans l'encadrement et le développement d'ingénieurs seniors, de Tech Leads et/ou d'architectes.
  • Une expertise approfondie en conception logicielle, systèmes distribués, architectures cloud-native et pratiques modernes d'ingénierie. Notamment avec l’usage de l’IA appliqués au Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC).
  • D'excellentes compétences en communication, en français comme en anglais.

Une expérience dans les services financiers, le secteur bancaire ou les paiements constitue un atout.

 

Pourquoi rejoindre Capco?

Capco est un cabinet de conseil international, spécialisé dans les services financiers.

Fondé en 1998, le cabinet compte aujourd’hui plus de 7 000 collaborateurs dans 36 bureaux à travers le monde, dont 160 à Paris.

Challenger reconnu face aux grands noms du conseil, Capco se distingue par sa double expertise métier et technologique, au service de la stratégie comme de l’exécution.

Notre promesse : accompagner la transformation de nos clients dans un monde en constante mutation réglementaire, technologique et opérationnel.

Nous intervenons à l’intersection du business, de la réglementation et de la tech, en mobilisant des équipes pluridisciplinaires, expérimentées et engagées.

 

Nos Marqueurs Distinctifs

  • Une spécialisation sectorielle forte Nous apportons à nos clients une compréhension approfondie de leurs enjeux métiers, en particulier dans la banque, les marchés de capitaux et l’énergie.
  • Une approche collaborative et sur mesure Nous intégrons les équipes clients, adaptons nos méthodes à leur culture et co-construisons des solutions concrètes et opérationnelles.
  • L’excellence comme exigence Notre ambition est d’obtenir des résultats mesurables et durables pour nos clients – et de toujours viser la valeur ajoutée.
  • Un esprit “One Capco” Nos équipes collaborent à l’échelle internationale pour mobiliser les meilleures expertises et partager les bonnes pratiques.
  • Une culture entrepreneuriale et inclusive L’innovation, l’initiative et le mérite sont au cœur de notre modèle. Nous valorisons les idées, la diversité et le progrès collectif.

 

Nos expertises s’articulent autour de 6 métiers complémentaires

  • Stratégie & Transformation
  • Finance, Risque & Conformité
  • Product, Innovation & Design
  • Data & Analytics
  • Conseil Tech (Advisory)
  • Engineering (Delivery)

 

Chez Capco, nous vous offrons

  • Un environnement de travail international centré sur l’innovation et la création de valeur pour nos clients bancaires et assuranciels
  • Un parcours de formation continu adapté à vos besoins, pour acquérir de nouvelles compétences et développer une réelle expertise
  • Une organisation de travail hybride (charte télétravail de 2 jours par semaine)
  • Une rémunération compétitive avec un bonus lié à la performance
  • Un PEE avec un abondement de 2903€ par an
  • Une culture d’entreprise entrepreneuriale, inclusive et méritocratique, de nouveau certifiée Great Place To Work
  • Des initiatives pour construire le Capco de demain :
    • #BeYourselfAtWork
    • Woman@capco
    • RSE (forfait mobilité durable, jour de solidarité, etc.)
    • Des communautés métiers, sportives et culturelles

Chez Capco Paris, handicap visible ou invisible, parcours atypique ou classique, toutes les candidatures sont les bienvenues et seront traitées avec équité.

Director, Partnerships

Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.

As we continue to scale our global platform, the Director, Partnerships will play a critical role in growing and commercialising strategic football partnerships across global markets.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Director, Partnerships will lead and develop strategic relationships with key partners, including national federations, premier league, league 1, and championship clubs, as well as global governing bodies and football associations. Serving as the primary strategic contact, this role drives revenue growth, elevates brand presence, and delivers exceptional commercial value to partners' retail businesses through cross-functional collaboration and senior-level relationship management. The Director, Partnerships delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.

HOW WILL YOU DRIVE IMPACT

Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)

  • Represent Fanatics as the trusted face of the brand within the sports community, building advisor-level relationships with senior stakeholders to ensure mutual satisfaction and long-term partner retention.
  • Introduce innovative ideas and best practices that enhance partnership value and deepen fan engagement across digital, in-venue, and retail touchpoints.
  • Drive revenue growth through partner activations and joint marketing initiatives that elevate the fan experience and strengthen commercial outcomes.
  • Monitor and analyse performance metrics to continuously optimise financial returns for both Fanatics and its partners, keeping the fan at the centre of every decision.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)

  • Stay current with industry trends, competitor activities, and developments in sports retail to proactively identify new commercialisation and renewal opportunities.
  • Develop and execute forward-thinking strategies that grow and commercially enhance partnerships with associations, leagues, and clubs.
  • Leverage data and market analysis to identify emerging opportunities, solve complex challenges, and inform strategic direction across the partnership portfolio.
  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement by introducing best practices that push the boundaries of what partnership value can deliver.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)

  • Lead strategic business reviews against contracts and business plans, presenting relevant performance data with internal teams to drive accountability and results.
  • Manage the full partnership lifecycle end-to-end, including onboarding, ongoing reviews, escalations, and relationship nurturing, ensuring every commitment is met on time and within plan.
  • Proactively identify risks and opportunities within the portfolio and take decisive action to protect and grow the value of each partnership.
  • Hold cross-functional teams accountable for delivering on partner goals, maintaining high standards of execution across all touchpoints.

Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)

Cross-Functional Leadership:

  • Collaborate with senior leadership, ecommerce, product development, licensing, new business, buying, marketing, and operations to align on launches and partner goals, ensuring seamless communication and delivery of commitments.
  • Drive alignment across internal stakeholders to ensure the organisation is consistently positioned to meet and exceed partner expectations.
  • Oversee internal teams supporting the partnership portfolio, fostering a high-performance environment built on clarity, collaboration, and shared accountability.

People Leadership:

  • Provide strong, inspiring leadership that builds confidence, drives effective change, and develops talent within the partnerships function.
  • Create a team culture grounded in BOLD principles, empowering individuals to take ownership, innovate, and deliver outstanding results for partners and fans alike.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY

We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:

  • Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
  • Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
  • Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
  • Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING

Required Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in partnerships, account management, or business development, preferably within sports, sports retail, or ecommerce environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage senior client relationships with strong negotiation and strategic thinking skills, and a proven track record of driving revenue growth through strategic partnerships.
  • Deep understanding of football club operations, league structures, and fan engagement strategies, with the ability to operate credibly at the highest levels of the sports industry.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to analyse complex data and market trends to inform strategy and optimise financial performance.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels, internally and externally.
  • Proven project management capability, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Willingness to travel internationally as required to support partner relationships and business objectives.

If you do not meet all of the requirements for the role, but still have relevant partnerships or account management experience please do reach out.

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Sports Management, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

ABOUT US
Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. title: Ingénieur en mécanique des fluides
employer: ECOLE NATIONALE SUPERIEURE DE TECHNIQUES AVANCEES
description: ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé. L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission : la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé, la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR). Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein de l’Unité de Formation et de Recherche (UFR) Mécanique. L’UFR de Mécanique a pour mission d’assurer la formation en mécanique des élèves du cursus ingénieur d’ENSTA, des élèves de masters de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, et la formation par la recherche d’étudiants français et étrangers au niveau master et doctorat. L’Unité développe également des activités de recherche dans le domaine de la mécanique des matériaux et des structures, de la mécanique des fluides, des vibrations et de l’acoustique. Ces activités sont réalisées grâce à un important parc expérimental de haut niveau en mécanique des solides et des fluides, tant pour l’enseignement que la recherche. Sur le campus de Brest, l’UFR de Mécanique compte une cinquantaine d’enseignants chercheurs, une cinquantaine de doctorants/post-doctorants ainsi qu’une dizaine de personnels techniques (ingénieurs, techniciens). Les activités de recherche des membres de l’UFR de Mécanique du site de Brest sont menées au sein de l’Institut de Recherche Dupuy de Lôme (IRDL, CNRS UMR 6027, www.irdl.fr ). La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les enseignants-chercheurs de l’ENSTA, pôle thématique de recherche « Structure Interaction Fluide (StIF) » de l’IRDL. L’ENSTA est l’un des partenaires du projet SEARENITY, retenu dans le cadre de l'appel à projets « CORIMER Navire Bas Carbone » (financement Ademe, France 2030). Le projet vise à développer un robot autonome capable d’intervenir en continu sur les coques de navires pour les nettoyer et limiter l’apparition d’algues et coquillages afin de réduire sa consommation énergétique et ses émissions de C02. L’ENSTA intervient sur 2 aspects du projet pour lequel les verrous techniques sont nombreux et pointus : le système d’attraction magnétique : définition, simulation et tests. le volet hydrodynamique du robot : modélisation, simulation numérique et essais en veine aérodynamique La présente fiche de poste concerne les aspects hydrodynamiques. Missions / Activités principales : La personne recrutée prendra en charge l’évaluation numérique des efforts subis par le robot dans différentes configurations d’opération, et proposera des pistes d’optimisation de forme, afin d’améliorer les performances. Les modèles développés seront également confrontés à des essais de validation dans la nouvelle veine aérodynamique de l’école. Elle sera amenée à produire des rapports et présentations techniques, mettre en œuvre des outils de simulation numérique et des essais, et travailler de manière collaborative avec l’ensemble des partenaires du projet SEARENITY. Les missions détaillées sont les suivantes : Etude expérimentale en soufflerie Essais de caractérisation et de validation en veine aérodynamique, afin de valider les simulations numériques pour l’estimation des efforts, en fonction de différents paramètres (influence de la vitesse de l’écoulement, influence de l’angle d’incidence). Mise en place du protocole d’essais, conception du support et impression 3D du modèle réduit de drone, calibrage des capteurs, mise en œuvre de la veine aérodynamique. 2. Etude numérique pour le fonctionnement en zone immergée Détermination numérique des efforts moyens rencontrés par le drone en condition réelle le long de la coque. Les simulations numériques seront réalisées avec un code de calcul commercial validé, constituant l’une des références à l’heure actuelle pour la simulation d’écoulements à haut Reynolds. 3. Dimensionnement des efforts d’impact en splash-zone Détermination numérique des efforts d’impact à la traversée de la surface libre, pour différentes vitesses du navire, et différents angles d’incidence du drone. Les simulations numériques seront réalisées à l’aide d’un code de calcul développé par l’ENSTA, spécifiquement dédié aux cas d’impacts. Plusieurs trajectoires de rentrée dans l’eau seront simulées, afin de cerner les efforts maximaux subis par la structure. 4. Optimisation de forme du robot Le fonctionnement nominal du drone en zone immergée, et la phase d’entrée dans l’eau conduisent à des formes géométriques optimales très différentes. Une étude bibliographique sera menée pour orienter la recherche d’une forme extérieure la plus adaptée, au sens d’un compromis sur les efforts acceptables. Cette étude bibliographique sera éventuellement complétée par des calculs de traînée et d’impact sur des géométries académiques, afin de fournir une aide à la décision pour les concepteurs du drone. L’Ecole étant engagée dans une démarche RSE (DD-RS et employeur pro-vélo), elle encourage aux mobilités douces par la mise en place de dispositif d’aide financière (FMD) et des infrastructures adaptées aux cyclistes ». Poste à temps complet (25 jours de congés annuels, 23 RTT annuels) Avantages : Transports (participation forfaitaire de l’employeur à hauteur de 75 %) Forfait mobilité durable (jusqu’à 300€/an) Possibilité de télétravail (après période d’essai et après accord du manager et dépôt d’une demande) Subvention employeur au restaurant administratif et/ou à la cafétéria de l’établissement Comité d’action sociale, avec notamment des événements et animations proposés au personnel, salle de sport sur adhésion, Mutuelle (participation à hauteur de 50% de l’établissement) Aménagement du poste de travail et recrutement inclusif : Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux candidats en situation de handicap. ENSTA s’engage à un recrutement favorisant l’égalité, la diversité et l’inclusion. Toutes les candidatures sans aucune distinction (âge, handicap, sexe, nationalité, religion, orientation sexuelle…) ont leur place dans notre processus de recrutement. Présentation de l’Ecole ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris) . Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans , inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment. ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne. Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027. Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap , dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle. Connaissances : Vous disposez des compétences suivantes : Formation supérieure en mécanique des fluides, énergétique, mécanique, génie maritime ou domaine équivalent. Solides connaissances en mécanique des fluides et en hydrodynamique navale. Expérience en simulation numérique des écoulements (CFD) et en analyse de résultats de calcul. Maîtrise d'au moins un langage de programmation scientifique (Python, C/C++, Fortran…). Compétences en traitement, analyse et visualisation de données scientifiques. Autonomie, rigueur scientifique, capacité à travailler en équipe et à conduire des campagnes de calculs et d'essais. Bon niveau d'anglais scientifique. Les compétences suivantes seraient appréciées : Compétences en méthodes particulaires, notamment en méthode SPH, ou intérêt marqué pour leur mise en œuvre. Expérience en expérimentation en mécanique des fluides. Connaissances en optimisation numérique et/ou optimisation de géométrie. Le recrutement s’inscrit dans le projet SUBPERF-AI, qui porte sur une démarche de réduction drastique du cycle de développement de nouveaux concepts sous-marins, en s’appuyant sur les progrès récents de l’intelligence artificielle (IA), et plus particulièrement le machine learning. Au contraire de l’existant en IA basé sur des modèles ininterprétables de type boîte noire, le projet vise à construire une méthodologie de construction de modèles physiques, de complexité adaptée à la physique sous-jacente, en ayant recours à l’expertise humaine et se plaçant comme un outil de conception complémentaire dans l’écosystème existant. Les objectifs principaux du projet sont : Développer une méthodologie de détermination automatisée du modèle d’efforts hydrodynamiques de corps sous-marin, avec utilisation de l’IA (machine learning), sur la base des données de la cinématique, des trajectoires, et des paramètres de contrôle, facilement accessibles, lors des essais maquette ou réel, ou lors d’une simulation numérique. Placer l’expert humain en capacité de contrôler la construction du modèle aux différents stades : qualité des données d’entrée, qualité de la phase d’apprentissage du modèle, et outils/règles de certification a posteriori. La personne recrutée sera intégrée dans une équipe pluridisciplinaire de 3 enseignants-chercheurs, un doctorant et un second post-doctorant. Missions / Activités principales : La personne recrutée prendra en charge la construction d’un modèle d’effort hydrodynamique « expert » et la génération de données expérimentales. Le modèle hydrodynamique expert sera déterminé en suivant la méthodologie classique de l’ITTC, à l’aide d’une campagne d’essais dans la veine aérodynamique pour la caractérisation des efforts (essais en modèle captif du type PMM (Planar Motion Mechanism)). Ce modèle sera implémenté dans un simulateur temporel, dont les résultats seront confrontés sur des manœuvres standards réalisées dans le bassin à drones de l’ENSTA. La confrontation des résultats de trajectoires expérimentales aux trajectoires simulées, obtenues sur la base des essais en modèle captif, pourra amener à questionner la méthodologie standard, en particulier lors de la présence de non-linéarités importantes ou de termes croisés non négligeables. Les essais en bassin fourniront par ailleurs les données de cinématique nécessaires au travail de thèse. Les missions détaillées sont les suivantes : Tâche 1 – conception et fabrication d’un drone sous-marin Conception d’un drone générique de géométrie simplifiée, et instrumenté. Le drone recevra un capotage extérieur, afin de tester plusieurs configurations : géométrie parallélépipédique typique d’un ROV d’exploration, et géométrie cylindrique de type drone torpille. Le drone sera instrumenté pour mesurer les paramètres de contrôle, la cinématique et les trajectoires, ainsi que les efforts propulsifs (poussée, couple) et les efforts de contrôle. Tâche 2 – essais statiques et dynamiques en modèle captif Réalisation d’essais de caractérisation dans la veine aérodynamique de l’ENSTA, en similitude complète de Reynolds, pour les vitesses envisagées d’utilisation en eau du drone. Mesure des efforts en statique, sur les 6 degrés de liberté. Caractérisation des efforts de plans porteurs et du propulseur. Mesure des efforts en dynamique, en mouvement forcé à l’aide de l’hexapode : masses et inerties ajoutées, termes liés aux vitesses angulaires. Tâche 3 – Identification dérivées hydrodynamiques Identification des dérivées hydrodynamiques (ou coefficients hydrodynamiques) à partir des essais en modèle captif. Tâche 4 – Adaptation du simulateur temporel Prise en main du simulateur temporel de l’ENSTA, et de l’environnement de développement. Adaptation du code de calcul pour intégrer des lois de commande issues de mesures expérimentales. Tâche 5 – Essais libres et standardisés, en bassin Réalisation d’essais aux trajectoires prédéfinies (zigzag horizontal ou vertical, accélération horizontale, …). Réalisation d’essais pour parcourir l’espace complet des 6 degrés de libertés. Enregistrement de l’historique des contrôles (vitesse hélice, angles plans porteurs, …), des trajectoires et des efforts des organes de contrôle. Tâche 6 – Rejeu trajectoires simulateur temporel Rejeu numérique des trajectoires, afin de valider si le modèle d’efforts est suffisamment complet pour prédire correctement les trajectoires mesurées expérimentalement. Les résultats obtenus amèneront à publication scientifique. Niveau de diplôme et formations Thèse de doctorat dans le domaine de l’hydrodynamique navale. This is a permanent position based in Paris.
 

💼 About the role

As an Account Performance Manager, you'll manage a portfolio of approximately 200 strategic merchants, both online and offline. These merchants generate an average annual turnover of between €1M and €3M with Alma.
Most of your portfolio will be based in France, with some international accounts as Alma continues to expand across Europe.
Your role will be to understand each merchant's business, identify opportunities for growth, maximize the value of the partnership and anticipate any behavior that could lead to churn.
SMB and Mid-Market accounts represent around 40% of Alma's margin, which makes your work critical to the company's success.

Your main responsibilities

  • Drive merchant performance

    • Upselling Alma's solutions

  • Improve the profitability of your portfolio

  • Prevent merchant churn
    Keep a close eye on merchant performance, market trends and competitor activity. Identify early warning signs and demonstrate Alma's value through relevant, data-driven recommendations.
  • Support Alma's international growth

  • Build smarter ways of working

How success will be measured

Your main objectives will be to:

Growth is part of the Revenue team. We build Alma's merchant acquisition engine: which merchants we target, how we find, identify and qualify them, how fast a qualified merchant reaches the right salesperson and, with lifecycle, how we convert, activate and retain them, in France and in our international markets.

We work AI-native, by design. Everyone in Growth works in Claude Code with a shared library of skills and connectors, a common repository that holds our workflow spec, our decision log and our merchant context, and a simple delivery lifecycle (Research → Spec → Plan → Build) where each stage ends with a human decision. Claude does the legwork; a person decides. Correctness comes from automated verification (tests, adversarial agent review, live validation), and every production change goes through a pull request with a named reviewer from DevX or SRE.

We are rebuilding our GTM system around five layers: market definition, signals, data & enrichment, decision & routing, and activation. As part of it, we are moving our merchant lifecycle off HubSpot to a modern customer engagement platform. Braze leads, Customer.io is in the running, and we want your view. You will lead that migration and the lifecycle programme built on top of it.

You will join a team of 6 with a Growth Ops, a Growth Engineer, a Paid Acquisition Manager, a Senior GTM Engineer (hiring) and an Experimentation & Tracking Engineer (hiring), and you will report to Julian, Team Lead Growth.

 

This position is a permanent contract (CDI) based in Paris, hybrid.

💼 About the job

Own the B2B lifecycle, from lead to active merchant

  • Design and run the journeys that drive revenue: lead nurturing, onboarding, activating signed merchants who haven't taken a first payment, retention and win-back.
  • Reach the right merchants at the right moment with the right message, using segments built on live data (industry, size, country, TPV, product usage).
  • Run a yearly campaign calendar (seasonal moments, product launches, credit upsell) next to the always-on journeys, with clear pressure rules. Start with email, then add in-app, POS materials for in-store merchants, and new channels when the data supports them.

Help drive Alma's move towards consumers

  • Alma is opening up to B2C, with new consumer products on the way. You'll be the first lifecycle person to work on it, and you'll get to invent how Alma talks to consumers.
  • It starts small next to the merchant work and is set to grow fast.

Lead the migration off HubSpot

  • Help pick the platform. Braze is the front-runner, and if you think Customer.io or another tool fits better, make the case.
  • Audit what runs today, decide what to rebuild, improve or drop, and plan the switch so no key communication stops along the way.
  • With the Growth Engineer and Data, define the data model, consent management and deliverability setup, then switch off HubSpot marketing on schedule.

Measure what you ship

  • Use control groups and A/B tests by default. Report on activations, reactivations and influenced TPV rather than open rates.
  • Build your own segments and analyses, and share what works with Sales, Account Management and Revenue Marketing.

Be the CRM project lead across Revenue

  • Align Sales, Account Management, Ops, Product Marketing, Brand and Legal on shared campaigns: you own the brief-to-delivery workflow, set the pace and arbitrate.
  • Make other teams autonomous on simple communications (templates, tone of voice, golden rules), so you can focus on the programmes that move revenue.

 

🗓️ Your first months

  • Months 1–3: you audit our current lifecycle (HubSpot workflows, onboarding emails, scattered tools), give your recommendation on the target platform and define its setup with the Growth Engineer, and keep priority campaigns running while you prepare the switch.
  • By month 6: onboarding, activation and retention journeys run on the new platform with control groups; HubSpot marketing is switched off; a yearly campaign calendar is shared with Sales, Account Management and Product Marketing.

🧰 You will work with

  • Lifecycle: Braze, Customer.io or equivalent (decision in progress). HubSpot until we switch it off.
  • Revenue systems & data: Salesforce (system of record), BigQuery, Looker
  • AI & delivery: Claude Code (skills, connectors), Notion, Linear

 

🧩 About you

To succeed in this job

  • 5+ years in lifecycle, CRM or marketing automation, across both B2B and B2C. On the B2B side, you have run programmes hand in hand with Sales or Account Management on large portfolios (1,000+ accounts). On the B2C side, you have built consumer activation and engagement journeys at scale.
  • A campaign manager first: you turn a business goal into a segment, a timing and a message, and you can show the revenue impact of your past programmes.
  • Hands-on with a modern customer engagement platform: Braze, Customer.io, Iterable or equivalent. You build journeys, segments and personalisation yourself, and you have opinions on what each tool does well and where it falls short. Having led or contributed to a platform migration is a strong asset.
  • Data autonomy: you pull your own segments and results from a BI tool (Looker or equivalent), design tests with control groups, and understand how data flows between a CRM, a warehouse and a marketing platform.
  • Cross-functional leadership: you have owned projects involving several teams without formal authority, and you know how to prioritise when everyone needs your time.
  • Excellent writing in native-level French (mandatory) and fluent English.

 

And it will be nice if you also

  • Have set up Braze, Customer.io or a similar platform from scratch, or helped choose one.
  • Have set up email deliverability (sending domains, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, IP warm-up).
  • Already use AI in your daily work for copy, QA or analysis.
  • Have worked in fintech, payments, a card launch, or with retail merchant networks.
  • Speak Spanish, Italian or German.

Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.

 

🧘 What's in it for you

  • Impact: 26,000 merchants in 10 countries, thousands of signed merchants still to activate, and a consumer audience to build. Every journey you ship shows up in TPV.
  • A clean start: you join in time to weigh in on the platform and set it up properly (data model, deliverability, governance) instead of inheriting years of workflow debt.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships that it builds, the creativity it brings to the table, and the collaboration of being together. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our employees can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

  • Recognize when a solution could benefit another product and take the initiative to explore it.
  • Connect engineering decisions to customer value, cost efficiency, and usability.

Who You Are:

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Alerting Platform Automation
description:
At Datadog, we process millions of monitors every minute, alerting our customers when configured thresholds are crossed. Engineers across the world trust us to alert them when necessary, so our Alerting stack needs to be reliable and scalable.

The Alerting Platform Automation team’s main goal is to improve the processes and tooling that let our Alerting developers operate the platform efficiently. We design and operate automation systems that replace manual actions, from creating environments to deploying and testing safely. We build test environments that give engineers and their AI coding tools fast, reliable feedback, so changes can be validated in minutes rather than days.

Our team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help us maintain and scale the Alerting platform. In this position, you’ll work daily with our users, understanding their needs, defining solutions, building the necessary tooling and communicating with all our stakeholders appropriately.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Build automation systems that create and manage Alerting environments, with a focus on fast, realistic test environments that shorten the feedback loop for engineers and AI-assisted development workflows.
  • Work with SRE, Core Infrastructure and the Alerting engineering teams to understand their needs and provide solutions.
  • Lead infrastructure projects and improve our CI/CD and developer tooling, including our deployment process.
  • Identify reliability bottlenecks, then design solutions to mitigate or eliminate them, including load testing and testing of infrastructure configuration before it reaches production.
  • Improve infrastructure isolation and make our services scale automatically with load.

Who You Are:

  • You’re interested in ops and infrastructure challenges, and you’re comfortable writing the code that automates them.
  • You can analyze a problem, identify its root cause and propose short-term and long-term solutions.

  • You communicate appropriately to your audience, from fellow devs to top management.
  • You work autonomously across multiple technologies owned by different teams, and you like to discover and learn new ones.
  • You think that infrastructure and code are equally important.
  • You’re curious about how AI-assisted development changes the way we build and test software, and you enjoy making tooling that works well for both humans and agents.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That’s okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.
