title: Partner Account Manager, Intégrateurs de solutions de gestion
description: Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ? Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance. Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre vision Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes. Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 350 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches! 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible 🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 🚀 Déjà plus de 1 000,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! Localisation et déplacements Poste basé à Paris , selon la politique hybride de Pennylane, avec des déplacements réguliers en France auprès des partenaires, de leurs équipes et lors d’événements professionnels. Le portefeuille pourra inclure des partenaires franciliens et nationaux ; son allocation définitive sera précisée avec le manager. Pourquoi ce rôle est-il important chez nous ? Les intégrateurs historiques disposent souvent d’une expertise métier reconnue, d’équipes commerciales et de conseil, ainsi que d’un parc de clients à accompagner. Ils peuvent contribuer fortement à la croissance de Pennylane, à la fois par la vente de nouvelles solutions et par le développement de leur parc existant. Pour transformer ce potentiel en résultats, il faut installer une dynamique commerciale durable : aligner les dirigeants et les équipes terrain, faire émerger des opportunités, améliorer la maîtrise du produit et faciliter la collaboration avec les équipes Pennylane. Tu aideras les partenaires à passer d’une relation de distribution ou de prescription à une collaboration active, structurée et créatrice de valeur. Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ? Tu piloteras le développement d’un portefeuille de partenaires intégrateurs, de la stratégie de compte jusqu’à l’exécution des plans d’action : Développer les comptes partenaires , en alignant les dirigeants, responsables commerciaux et équipes opérationnelles autour d’objectifs communs. Accélérer le business Resell et Cosell , en animant les opportunités, en améliorant leur qualité et en aidant les partenaires à faire progresser leurs cycles de vente. Faire monter les équipes partenaires en compétence , grâce à des démonstrations, des formations et un accompagnement commercial concret. Créer une dynamique de croissance sur le parc existant , en identifiant les opportunités de déploiement, de migration et d’équipement des clients des intégrateurs. Faire rayonner les apprentissages du terrain , en partageant les résultats, les besoins partenaires et les leviers qui fonctionnent avec l’équipe Partnerships et les autres équipes internes. Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ? 1. Construire et déployer les plans de croissance des partenaires Comprendre le modèle économique, l’organisation, les priorités et le potentiel de chaque intégrateur. Construire avec les dirigeants et responsables commerciaux des plans de compte ambitieux, assortis d’objectifs et d’étapes concrètes. Identifier les leviers de croissance adaptés à chaque partenaire : développement du parc, nouveaux projets, campagnes ciblées, événements ou actions conjointes. Mobiliser les sponsors et les équipes terrain pour ancrer le partenariat dans les pratiques commerciales et opérationnelles. Prioriser ton temps et les ressources internes en fonction du potentiel et de l’impact attendu. 2. Animer le business Resell et Cosell Créer et entretenir une relation de confiance avec les décideurs, les équipes commerciales et les consultants du partenaire. Suivre le pipeline Resell et Cosell, assurer la qualité des opportunités et rendre le forecast fiable. Aider le partenaire à qualifier les besoins, structurer les opportunités et mobiliser les bons interlocuteurs Pennylane. Coordonner les actions avec les Account Executives et clarifier les rôles sur les cycles de vente partagés. Détecter les risques, débloquer les situations et accélérer les opportunités pertinentes jusqu’à leur conclusion. 3. Développer le parc et les opportunités chez les clients des intégrateurs Identifier avec le partenaire les segments de clients et les cas d’usage prioritaires. Construire des plans d’action pour équiper ou faire migrer les clients du parc lorsqu’une opportunité pertinente existe. Aider le partenaire à organiser la prospection, la qualification et le suivi des projets issus de son réseau. Participer à des rendez-vous clients, démonstrations ou événements lorsque cela peut accélérer le business ou renforcer la relation. Suivre l’impact des actions engagées et capitaliser sur les approches qui produisent des résultats. 4. Former et rendre les équipes partenaires plus autonomes Maîtriser la proposition de valeur et les principaux cas d’usage de Pennylane afin de réaliser des démonstrations convaincantes. Former les équipes commerciales du partenaire à présenter la valeur de la solution, au-delà des seules fonctionnalités. Aider les consultants et équipes opérationnelles à comprendre les conditions d’un déploiement réussi et à orienter les clients vers les bons interlocuteurs. Préparer les partenaires à leurs rendez-vous, événements clients et temps forts commerciaux. Adapter ton accompagnement aux profils et au niveau de maturité des équipes du partenaire. 5. Être présent sur le terrain et faire vivre la relation Assurer une présence physique régulière auprès des partenaires prioritaires, notamment lors de revues d’activité, de rendez-vous dirigeants et d’actions commerciales. Préparer et animer des revues de partenariat qui débouchent sur des décisions, des responsables et des prochaines étapes claires. Entretenir un réseau de contacts au-delà de l’interlocuteur principal afin de sécuriser la continuité du partenariat. Identifier tôt les signaux de risque, les irritants et les sujets nécessitant un arbitrage. Représenter Pennylane auprès des partenaires avec exigence, réactivité et transparence. 6. Collaborer en interne et contribuer à la stratégie Partnerships Coordonner les plans partenaires avec les équipes AE, Marketing, Ops, Produit et les équipes d’accompagnement concernées. Faire remonter des retours terrain précis sur les besoins des intégrateurs, les objections, les évolutions de marché et les opportunités commerciales. Proposer des initiatives marketing, commerciales ou produit pour accélérer la croissance des partenaires. Partager les bonnes pratiques et les succès avec l’équipe afin de contribuer à la performance collective. Maintenir des informations fiables dans le CRM et respecter les processus de vente et de suivi partenaires. Profil recherché : Compétences incontournables : Tu as une expérience confirmée en vente indirecte B2B, gestion de comptes partenaires ou développement de réseaux de revendeurs et d’intégrateurs; Tu as idéalement au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans un environnement logiciel ou SaaS B2B ; une expérience plus senior sera appréciée pour gérer des partenaires stratégiques et des cycles complexes; Tu sais élaborer et piloter des plans de croissance avec des interlocuteurs de niveau direction et des équipes opérationnelles; Tu as une approche commerciale orientée résultats, sais piloter un pipeline et transformer les analyses en actions concrètes; Tu es à l’aise dans les rendez-vous terrain, les négociations, les présentations et les démonstrations produit; Tu sais engager plusieurs parties prenantes chez un partenaire et construire une relation de confiance dans la durée; Tu es proactif, créatif et résilient : tu sais prendre des initiatives et maintenir une dynamique même lorsque les résultats prennent du temps; Tu es rigoureux dans le suivi des opportunités, le forecast et l’utilisation du CRM; Tu apprécies le travail en équipe et sais collaborer avec des fonctions commerciales, marketing, produit et opérations; Tu maîtrises le français et peux participer à des échanges professionnels en anglais. Atouts appréciés Une connaissance des solutions de comptabilité, finance, gestion, ERP ou logiciels de gestion pour les PME; Une expérience auprès d’intégrateurs, de revendeurs, de VAR ou d’éditeurs logiciels B2B. Une bonne compréhension des écosystèmes de distribution logicielle et des enjeux de déploiement chez les clients; Une expérience de gestion de grands comptes partenaires, de plans de migration de parc ou de cycles Resell et Cosell. Ce que nous recherchons surtout : Au-delà de ton expérience, nous recherchons une personne qui : Sait créer rapidement de la confiance et de la crédibilité auprès de dirigeants et d’équipes terrain; Aime être au contact des partenaires et transforme cette proximité en actions commerciales mesurables; Sait conjuguer vision stratégique du compte et exécution opérationnelle au quotidien; Est à la fois autonome, coachable et généreuse dans le partage de ses apprentissages avec l’équipe; A envie de contribuer à la croissance d’un réseau historique tout en faisant évoluer ses pratiques. Process de recrutement : Screening Talent Acquisition — 45 min : motivation, expérience en partenariats logiciels, connaissance de l’écosystème et disponibilité pour les déplacements. Entretien Hiring Manager — 45 min : réalisations concrètes, gestion de portefeuille, activation et développement de partenaires, approche terrain et collaboration. Étude de cas — environ 1 h : analyse d’un portefeuille d’intégrateurs, proposition d’un plan de croissance, priorisation du pipeline Resell/Cosell et présentation d’une approche de démonstration ou d’enablement. Entretien final — environ 45 min : vision du canal, contribution stratégique, collaboration transverse et adéquation avec les ambitions de Pennylane. 🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir : 🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind) 🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile) 🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés 🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking 🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris 💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE 🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib 💻 Un Mac 🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous. Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra: -Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules) -Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant -Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes -Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne. title: Stage Marketing B2B
description:
Artefact is an international consulting and engineering company specialising in data and AI, and a European leader in its field. Our headquarters is located in Paris. For the past 10 years, we have focused on designing and deploying artificial intelligence technologies and data-driven solutions.

Headquartered in Paris, we are now present in 24 countries across all continents, with 1,700 employees worldwide.

Our mission is to help businesses unlock the full potential of AI and data by developing bespoke solutions tailored to their specific business challenges. As pioneers in this domain, we combine technological expertise with operational excellence, working closely with leading players in the market. Our clients span all key sectors of the economy – including industry, retail, luxury, FMCG, healthcare, and finance – and include major international groups.

Beyond consulting, we are strongly committed to promoting ethical and accessible AI. We have launched the School of Data to support career transitions into tech roles, and established an AI Research Centre in both Paris and Shanghai.

In the context of Artefact’s accelerating growth, we are looking for a B2B Marketing Intern to join our Marketing team starting in January 2027.

 

The role :

Are you passionate about B2B marketing in the Tech area and want to work in an environment where your impact on business growth is recognised?

If this sounds like you, and you’re ready to step-up your career and level of responsibility, then you might just be our next B2B Marketing Assistant Intern.

The Marketing team at Artefact directly contributes to the business by engaging with existing clients and prospects to convert them as leads to generate sales. We do so by working closely with the heads of departments & consultant teams, as well as using KPI to make sure we create the right marketing deliverables and use the right channels to drive engagement, and ultimately leads and revenue.  

We do this through demand generation campaigns and events/webinars’ organisation, combined with PPC and social advertising to ensure brand and lead-gen campaigns support business objectives.

You’ll be working closely with the rest of the Artefact’s worldwide Marketing team, that’s why fluently speaking in English to share your best practices and train your peers is also required. You will be collaborating with the Marketing Specialists Global and France of the team, who report to the CMO of the Group, all based in Paris.

 

What you will do:

  • Using our marketing automation tool (Pardot) to conceive and roll-out mailing and lead nurturing campaigns (mailings, newsletters, landing pages) to drive customer acquisition.
  • Helping to organize events (webinars, business breakfasts, podcasts, participation in trade fairs & conferences with booths and speaking slots) and ensure a multi-channel attractive communications of these events through our website & landing pages, mailing series and social media (LinkedIn and Instagram).
  • Managing LinkedIn advertising campaigns according to objectives (awareness, acquisition) mixing organic and paid approach, to support and generate leads for the management team. 
  • Copywriting for PPC ads (LinkedIn) and landing pages thanks to engaging and attractive communication
  • Coordinating with our design team and briefing them to craft impactful and visually appealing assets that effectively communicate our key messages on social media every day.. 
  • Analyzing our Marketing Performance dashboards to understand and improve how our inbound marketing activity turns into and converts customers. 
  • Building effective stakeholder relationships (the Growth Tribe (Consulting Partners & Directors) freelancers, agencies, Tech Partners), ensuring all parties are kept informed throughout the campaigns and post activation.

 

Skills & Requirements

The candidate will be an enthusiastic and hardworking young professional, excited to join our fast paced marketing team. You will be a confident communicator, have a passion for lead generation and a genuine interest in the tech industry and BtoB marketing.

  • Master in Marketing
  • Fluency in English
  • Strong project management and multitasking skills in a deadline-driven environment
  • Experience working with CRM and Marketing Automation automation systems such as Salesforce.com and Eloqua/Pardot/HubSpot etc
  • LinkedIn expertise in organic and paid
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills (copywriting, editing and presentation) and ability to easily interact with virtual colleagues
  • Strong attention to details
  • A logical thinker, who’s proactive and results driven
  • High level of motivation, confidence and resilience
  • A team player, able to collaborate and communicate with other marketing professionals around the world

DIE ROLLE

Für unsere Kunden aus dem Banken- und Versicherungsumfeld suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n (Senior) Consultant / Business Analyst mit Fokus auf Kundenprozesse und CRM. Du gestaltest gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen, IT und Projektteams, wie Finanzinstitute ihre Kundinnen und Kunden über den gesamten Lebenszyklus betreuen: vom Onboarding über die laufende Kundenbeziehung bis zum Offboarding.

Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Business, Technologie und Daten. Du analysierst bestehende Prozesse und Systeme, übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in klare Spezifikationen und begleitest die Umsetzung in CRM- und Client-Lifecycle-Management-Lösungen. Dabei denkst du dich schnell in neue Themen und Kundenorganisationen ein und bringst Projekte proaktiv voran.

DEIN CAPCO-ALLTAG

  • Du analysierst Kundenprozesse entlang des Client Lifecycle, z. B. Onboarding, KYC, Stammdatenpflege, Kundenbetreuung und Offboarding, und identifizierst Verbesserungs- und Automatisierungspotenziale.
  • Du erhebst, strukturierst und priorisierst fachliche und technische Anforderungen und übersetzt sie in Use Cases, User Stories und Spezifikationen.
  • Du modellierst Ist- und Soll-Prozesse mit BPMN sowie Daten- und Systemzusammenhänge mit UML und schaffst so eine gemeinsame Sprache für Fachbereich und IT.
  • Du begleitest die Einführung, Weiterentwicklung und Integration von CRM-Lösungen (z. B. Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365), von der Konzeption über Test und Abnahme bis zum Go-live.
  • Du moderierst Workshops mit Stakeholdern aus Business, IT und Operations, zeigst Optionen und Abhängigkeiten auf und bereitest Entscheidungsvorlagen für das Management vor.
  • Du stellst die Nachvollziehbarkeit von den Geschäftszielen über die Anforderungen bis zur umgesetzten Lösung sicher.
  • Als Senior übernimmst du Verantwortung für Teilprojekte oder Workstreams und gibst dein Wissen an jüngere Kolleginnen und Kollegen weiter.

DEIN CAPCO-FIT

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Beratungserfahrung, idealerweise in einer Management- oder IT-Beratung mit Fokus auf Financial Services.
  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit CRM-Themen und -Tools, insbesondere in Projekten zur Einführung, Weiterentwicklung oder Integration von CRM-Systemen.
  • Fundierte Branchenkenntnisse im Banken- oder Versicherungsumfeld, vor allem rund um Kundenprozesse und Client Lifecycle Management.
  • Solide Methodenkompetenz in der Business-Analyse: Anforderungsmanagement, Prozessmodellierung mit BPMN und UML sowie Erfahrung mit agilen und klassischen Projektmethoden.
  • Nachweisbare Projekterfahrung an der Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereich und IT.
  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Du arbeitest dich zügig in neue Themen, Systeme und Kundenumfelder ein und lieferst früh Mehrwert.
  • Du bist motiviert, proaktiv und lösungsorientiert, übernimmst Verantwortung und überzeugst durch klare, strukturierte Kommunikation.
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (C1/C2) sind ein Muss, sehr gute Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab.

BONUSPUNKTE FÜR

  • Erfahrung mit regulatorischen Anforderungen im Kundenumfeld, z. B. KYC/AML, MiFID II bzw. FIDLEG oder Datenschutz (DSG/DSGVO).
  • Erfahrung mit angrenzenden Themen wie Customer Data Management, Omnichannel, Marketing Automation oder Customer Experience.
  • Zertifizierungen in Business-Analyse oder CRM (z. B. IREB CPRE, CBAP, Salesforce-Zertifizierungen).
  • Erfahrung in agilen Setups (Scrum, SAFe) als Business Analyst oder Product Owner.

 

Inklusion bei Capco

Wir setzen uns für einen barrierefreien und zugänglichen Bewerbungsprozess ein. Wenn Du in irgendeiner Phase Unterstützung oder Anpassungen benötigst, lass es uns bitte wissen – wir helfen gerne weiter. Wir schätzen unterschiedliche Perspektiven und Hintergründe. Bei Capco glauben wir daran, dass Individualität eine Stärke ist. Unsere #BeYourselfAtWork-Kultur fördert Vielfalt und Zusammenarbeit – und prägt, wie wir täglich mit unseren Kundinnen und Kunden sowie miteinander arbeiten.

title: Senior Specialist, QA
description:
About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

  • HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

  • HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

  • HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

  • HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Overview of Role: 

The Senior Specialist, QA will provide operational leadership and quality oversight for the review, approval and release-readiness of clinical and commercial product batches. 

The role is responsible for ensuring that batch documentation is complete, accurate, traceable, and compliant with applicable GMP requirements, approved procedures and regulatory commitments before submission to QA for final disposition or QP certification. The person will coordinate batch-release activities across Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs and external manufacturing partners, ensuring that issues are identified, escalated and resolved in a timely manner. The position will also lead process improvements, support inspection readiness and promote high standards of data integrity and Good Documentation Practice across the batch-release process. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Batch Review and Release Readiness 
  • Coordinate the end-to-end QA review of executed batch manufacturing, packaging, testing and release documentation for IMP and Commercial biological batch records. 
  • Coordinate the preparation and collation of batch documentation required for final batch disposition or QP certification from internal and external sources. 
  • Verify that batch records are complete, accurate, and compliant with approved procedures, specifications and applicable GMP requirements. 
  • Confirm that relevant deviations, investigations, change controls, CAPAs, and laboratory results have been appropriately assessed and approved before release. 
  • Identify documentation gaps, discrepancies and potential compliance risks, and coordinate their timely resolution. 
  • Maintain oversight of batch-release priorities, review status, outstanding actions, and planned release dates. 
  • Escalate critical issues or potential delays to Quality leadership and relevant stakeholders. 
  • Ensure that batch-release documentation is appropriately archived and readily retrievable electronically. 

 

  • Quality Systems and Compliance: 
  • Ensure batch-release activities are performed in accordance with current GMP, Good Documentation Practice, data-integrity principles, and internal procedures. 
  • Support the effective operation of quality systems associated with deviations, CAPAs, change controls, document control, and training. 
  • Review and approve relevant quality documents, including SOPs, work instructions, forms, checklists, and batch-release procedures. 
  • Maintain controlled documentation and ensure that current approved versions are available to relevant personnel. 
  • Support periodic reviews of procedures and identify opportunities to strengthen compliance and operational effectiveness. 
  • Promote the appropriate use of electronic quality and document management systems. 
  • Act as a subject-matter expert for batch documentation, release-readiness and associated document-control processes for all batch release activities. 
  • Internal Team Coordination (EU QA) 
  • Provide day-to-day leadership and technical guidance to QA batch reviewers and supporting personnel. 
  • Plan and allocate batch-review activities according to business priorities, product demand, and release timelines. 
  • Monitor team workload, quality metrics, and completion of assigned activities. 
  • Develop and deliver training in Good Documentation Practice, batch-record review and relevant quality-system processes. 
  • Support onboarding and qualifications of new QA team members. 
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and continuous-improvement culture within the QA function. 

 

  • External Team Collaboration: 
  • Work closely with Manufacturing, Quality Control / CMC, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Supply and other relevant functions to support timely batch release. 
  • Coordinate with all Summit CMOs, testing laboratories and service providers to obtain missing documents and resolve release-related queries. 
  • Communicate batch status, risks, priorities and outstanding actions clearly to internal and external stakeholders. 
  • Support changes affecting batch documentation or release processes. 
  • Participate in cross-functional meetings concerning batch disposition, documentation, readiness, and supply continuity internally. 

 

  • Inspection Readiness and Continuous Improvement 
  • Maintain batch-release processes and supporting records in a continuous state of inspection of readiness. 
  • Support regulatory inspections, customer audits, internal audits, and supplier audits. 
  • Retrieve and present batch documentation and quality-system records during audits and inspections. 
  • Track batch-review metrics, recurring documentation issues, cycle times, and overdue actions. 
  • Analyse trends and recommend improvements to increase efficiency, right-first-time performance and compliance. 
  • Lead or contribute to Lean and process-optimization initiatives within the batch-release function. 
  • Support the implementation and enhancement of electronic quality, document management and reporting systems. 

Qualifications and Experience 

  • Essential 
  • Recognized qualification in Quality, Pharmaceutical Science, Life Sciences, Engineering or related discipline. 
  • Significant experience in Quality Assurance within a pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical or similarly regulated manufacturing environment – preferably in Biologic manufacturing, Packaging and Labelling environments.  
  • Practical experience reviewing executed batch records and supporting batch disposition or QP certification activities. 
  • Knowledge of GMP, Good Documentation Practice, and data-integrity requirements. 
  • Experience working with deviations, investigations, CAPAs, and change controls. 
  • Experience using electronic quality, document management and other enterprise-systems - systems such as MasterControl, NetSuite, Veeva Vault, TrackWise, SAP or equivalent platforms. 
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple priorities and deliver against critical release timelines. 
  • Experience supporting the release of medicinal products or investigational medicinal products. 
  • Experience working with contract manufacturing organizations and external testing laboratories 

 

  • Key Competencies 
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy 
  • Sound quality and compliance judgement 
  • Leadership and team coordination 
  • Effective prioritization and workload management 
  • Problem-solving and risk-based decision-making 
  • Clear communication and stakeholder management 
  • Audit and inspection readiness 
  • Data integrity and information governance 
  • Process improvement and operational efficiency 
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment 

 

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor. The total compensation package for this position may also include bonus, stock, benefits and/or other applicable variable compensation.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description: Building the intelligence behind Solskin Are you a driven person who wants to make buildings come alive? We are Zurich Soft Robotics (ZSR), a Zurich-based startup developing Solskin – a climate-adaptive solar facade. Solskin is not just a PV system or a shading system; it’s an intelligent skin that uses weather and building data, occupant feedback, and AI algorithms to decide how the facade moves, so buildings stay comfortable, avoid overheating, and use energy as efficiently as possible. Solskin is already running on several buildings across Switzerland, with many more to follow. In this role, you own the software that makes that happen. You write the code that runs Solskin, keep it reliable in the field, and constantly improve it. You will also architect and lead our future sensor-to-data platform. Your focus is where software meets hardware, and the control and AI on top of it. You don't need to be a front-end specialist. What you will do This is a hands-on leadership position: you code every day. Own the full stack: You maintain and develop the whole software stack, from cloud and data management to user-facing applications, and from low-level embedded firmware to high-level AI controllers learning from users. You keep it reliable and keep making it better. Be the link between the teams: You build the software that runs on real buildings and support the hardware team. You also build the internal tools used by sales and the business team. Lead what comes next : With the CEO and CTO, you set the software direction and lead development of future products. Our stack: Backend: Python, FastAPI, PyTorch Frontend: React, TypeScript Hardware: C/C++, STM32 microcontrollers, Beckhoff PLCs Database: PostgreSQL (TimescaleDB) DevOps & Cloud: Linux, Docker, AWS, Grafana What we are looking for Required: Education : MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or similar. Python : This is a must. You write clean Python that runs in production, on real systems. Embedded & Hardware: Shipped C/C++ on microcontrollers running on physical hardware; comfortable working with sensors, actuators, and basic electronics. Applied AI & Control: Understanding of modern control and ML/RL methods, with hands-on PyTorch experience applied to physical or dynamic systems. Cloud & data : You are comfortable with PostgreSQL, Docker and AWS. Leadership attitude : You take ownership, make decisions, and want to grow as a leader. Languages : English. German is a big plus. Hybrid setting : You will be expected to be on-site at least three days per week, and sometimes at customers’ locations, to work on real products. Availability : 100%, as soon as possible. Work-permit: You need the right to work in Switzerland for this position. Preferred: Startup experience: You have worked in a startup before and know what that means. Building modeling and control: You have prior experience handling building data, modeling building dynamics, and developing building controllers; ideally with ML and RL tools. Frontend: React and TypeScript. Mindset: Hands-on: You lead, and you still do the hard work yourself. Fast: You are pragmatic and iterate quickly. Things break, and plans change, and that doesn't scare you. Purpose: You care about climate and want to make buildings smarter. Benefits Impact: Your code runs on real buildings. You see the result of your work. Ownership: A key role with a real say in our product and technology, and room to grow with the company. Flexibility: Hybrid work and flexible hours. We like being in the Zurich office together, so plan for regular office days. Team: A small, skilled, and down-to-earth team that helps each other out. The reality: We are a startup. It is often messy; things rarely work the first time, and the workload is real. In return, you get a lot of freedom and responsibility from day one. Sounds like you? Send us your CV and a short document instead of a classic cover letter. It doesn’t need to be long, just enough for us to understand who you are and where you stand. Please cover these points: About you: A short description of yourself. Proud of: One thing you are really proud of, in a few sentences. Startup: Why do you fit a startup? Software meets hardware: Your experience where software and hardware come together. Juggeling many hats: You’ll rarely finish one thing from A to Z without interruptions: different stacks, different people, different projects, and on-site surprises. Describe a time your work was like that, and how you handled it. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist
description: About Papers Papers AG is a Swiss cyber security engineering house and an incubator for our product portfolio. We build device-level alternatives to centralized cloud and trust. Our strategy is to grow our foundational decentralized network by building high-demand enterprise products directly on top of it. Your portfolio includes: Acurast: Decentralized confidential compute running on ordinary smartphones. Obsidio: A continuous, AI-assisted pentesting subscription. Incubated by Papers, Obsidio is built directly on Acurast, leveraging the decentralized network as a unique compute moat to battle-test networks. Hypergate: Enterprise mobile single sign-on for managed Android and iOS fleets. As an engineering-driven team, we work with autonomy and purpose. Our culture is built on meritocracy, long-term thinking, and a commitment to quality over buzz, innovation is in our DNA. We aim to collaborate with people who love tech for its own sake and want to help shape the future by solving real-world challenges. Your role We are seeking a tech-savvy, execution-oriented Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist to serve as the engine powering our growth campaigns, content infrastructure, and data analytics pipeline. Your main goal will be to communicate our stories across a portfolio of brands by bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI, data operations, and tactical growth marketing. You’ll be building automated content workflows, ensuring the highest quality across everything we generate, running multi-channel campaigns from start to finish, and maintaining rock-solid attribution tracking. If you are obsessed with efficiency, operational speed, and using AI to scale output without ever sacrificing quality and if you thrive when given a blank slate to write your own playbook, this role is for you. Success Metrics (First 90 Days) 30 Days: Take full ownership of the existing marketing tech stack and establish baseline performance metrics. 60 Days: Fully automate the core content generation pipeline and establish QA workflows. 90 Days: Launch at least two multi-channel growth experiments and demonstrate a measurable reduction in CAC or an increase in content throughput. Core Responsibilities 1. Storytelling That Converts Making Complexity Clear: Take complex, often highly technical capabilities and features and turn them into clear, digestible stories without losing accuracy. Audience-First Messaging: Understand who the campaigns speak to (developers, technical decision-makers, business stakeholders or end users) and frame each capability around what that audience cares about, at the right level of technical depth. Spark Curiosity & Action: Craft narratives that get audiences interested and excited, and that move them to the desired conversion. Product & Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with product and engineering teams to deeply understand what is being built, so every story is both compelling and technically correct. 2. Tactical Deployment & Agile Execution Multi-Channel Campaign Launch: Execute and launch integrated campaigns across communities, social channels, search, newsletters, loyalty programs, influencers, paid ads and landing pages. Where needed, bring in and coordinate additional third parties to support execution, such as external PR firms and campaign support providers. Marketing Automation: Maintain and scale lifecycle workflows, lead scoring mechanisms, drip sequences, and automated triggers to optimize lead conversion through the relevant funnel. Rapid A/B & Multivariate Testing: Design, set up, and evaluate rapid growth experiments (copy variants, landing page layouts, audience segmentation, offer positioning) on a weekly sprint cycle. 3. AI Pipeline Operation & Content QA Automated Workflow Orchestration: Build, maintain, and optimize AI-driven content pipelines to generate high-quality marketing assets at scale. Human-in-the-Loop Quality Assurance: Establish strict QA processes to review, refine, and approve AI-generated copy, visual assets, landing page content, and email sequences before deployment. Prompt Engineering & Template Optimization: Continuously iterate on, standardize, and version-control skills, design systems and context workflows to ensure output matches brand voice, compliance standards, and conversion best practices. Scale & Efficiency Metrics: Track content throughput, error rates, and time-to-market reduction, driving continuous improvement in pipeline efficiency. 4. Analytics, Attribution & Data Ops Tracking Infrastructure: Implementation and maintenance of event tracking, pixel setups, UTM parameters, and server-side tracking across all digital properties. Attribution Modeling: Own multi-touch attribution models to accurately trace pipeline generation, conversions, and revenue back to specific campaigns, channels, and AI-driven experiments. Data Integrity & Governance: Regularly audit marketing data across CRMs, marketing automation platforms, and internal databases to clean anomalies and maintain a single source of truth. Performance Reporting: Build and manage real-time dashboards providing actionable insights into CAC, LTV, conversion rates, and ROI across experiments. What We Are Looking For Essential Experience & Qualifications 3–5+ Years in Growth/Marketing Operations: Proven track record in a fast-paced B2B or B2C growth environment, managing campaign ops, marketing automation, and technical data pipelines. Passionate Builder: You deeply identify with our products. We are a fast-moving, mission-driven team, and this role requires intrinsic dedication rather than a standard 9-to-5 mentality. Hands-on AI Tooling Expertise: Demonstrated experience applying modern LLMs and generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Higgsfield) into real-world marketing workflows, beyond simple basic prompts. Technical Analytics Proficiency: Deep hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and data visualization tools. Automation Skills: Proficiency with automation platforms to connect API endpoints and pass payload data reliably. CRM & Automation Platforms: Direct administration experience with platforms like Zoho. Preferred Technical Skills Basic technical understanding of Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS for lightweight API scripting, data manipulation and rapid landing page iterations Mindset & Soft Skills Systems Thinking: Ability to map out complex, multi-step processes and translate business requirements into efficient technical architecture. Agile Adaptability: Comfort operating in fast-paced sprint cycles with changing priorities and a bias toward continuous shipping and learning. Obsessive Attention to Detail: An eagle eye for QA; AI speeds up production, but your judgment ensures quality control and brand alignment. Working Environment & Expectations Execution Velocity: We prioritize shipping experiments quickly, learning from real-world data, and iterating fast. Tooling Ownership & Independence: You will have complete autonomy over our stack. We expect you to proactively recommend and implement the best modern automation and AI solutions. You define the tools you need to win. Asynchronous Communication: Clear documentation, meticulous task tracking, and transparent status updates are core to how we work, allowing you to manage your own time effectively. Why join Papers? Work with cutting-edge technology that actually matters with a team that is obsessed with redefining what cutting edge means. High ownership, low bureaucracy. Your voice drives the strategy, giving you the independence to define your own processes. Influence the Growth strategy from day one. Competitive compensation structure tied directly to your impact, with clear pathways for career growth. 25 days paid vacation per year. Regular team events and retreats (at least quarterly). Support for your ongoing learning and development.r Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Embedded Performance Engineer
description:
Auterion builds a cutting-edge operating system for autonomous robotic systems that empower a diverse range of platforms to perform surveillance, reconnaissance, inspection, mapping and logistics tasks. Our industry-leading software drives the adoption of robotic fleets and is recognized by the U.S. government as the future standard for its drone programs. 

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Performance Engineer who is passionate about getting the most out of embedded systems — from low-level Linux tuning and hardware integration to high-performance video and data pipelines. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to hardware, moving across the stack, and solving the kinds of problems where milliseconds, bandwidth, startup time, and system efficiency matter.

You will work across the AuterionOS ecosystem on topics such as:

  • Embedded Linux performance and system tuning
  • Low-latency video streaming and media pipelines
  • C/C++, Python, and Bash-based platform development
  • Hardware integration, system profiling, and end-to-end optimization
  • Collaboration with experienced and driven engineers across Auterion

Responsibilities

  • Work within the Apps & Simulation team and collaborate with other development teams to build high-performance products for autonomous systems.
  • Design, optimize, and maintain performance-critical components within AuterionOS, Auterion’s custom embedded Linux distribution.
  • Improve end-to-end system behavior across compute, networking, video, and hardware interfaces, with a strong focus on latency, throughput, reliability, and resource efficiency.
  • Analyze and optimize demanding workloads such as real-time telemetry, video streaming, media processing, and communication between distributed system components.
  • Investigate system bottlenecks across the full stack, from kernel and OS behavior to application-level code and tooling.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand both internal and customer use cases, and translate them into robust technical solutions.
  • Propose and implement new platform capabilities with a strong emphasis on measurable performance gains in real-world deployments.
  • Participate in daily stand-ups, release planning, and prioritization discussions.

Qualifications and Skills

  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of professional experience writing object-oriented C++ and/or Python.
  • Deep experience with embedded Linux systems, including cross-compilation, debugging, profiling, and performance tuning.
  • Strong hands-on background in diagnosing and optimizing real-world system behavior, including CPU, memory, I/O, networking, boot time, and application latency.
  • Experience building or optimizing low-latency video or data-streaming pipelines, ideally on embedded platforms.
  • Excellent understanding of software systems that span embedded devices, higher-level applications, and fully integrated products.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including system design, implementation, debugging, and testing.
  • Experience with video codecs, GStreamer, RTP/RTSP, or hardware-accelerated media pipelines.
  • Solid experience with Debian/Ubuntu-based systems, Bash scripting, and systemd.
  • Experience with Docker and docker-compose in complex development and deployment environments, as well as qemu.
  • Strong debugging and performance analysis skills at both system and application level, combined with a proactive and self-directed working style.
  • Proficient in ROS2/DDS-style middleware and experienced with networking across multiple OSI layers, including REST APIs and performance-sensitive communication paths.
  • Experience with system integration and interfacing sensors or peripherals, especially via USB and Ethernet.
  • Experience working in an agile engineering environment with stand-ups, sprint planning, and shared ownership across teams.
  • Bonus: Experience with build systems such as CMake, including improving build performance in large-scale software projects.

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Company pension plan 
  • Car parking  
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
  • Mental health and wellbeing support
  • Learning and development opportunities

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

title: IoT Engineer
description: Do you enjoy working across the full IoT stack? In this role you’ll design embedded firmware for low-power devices, connect them through BLE, LoRa or Cellular, and build the cloud architecture and fleet management systems that run them at scale. You’ll work closely with firmware, hardware and cloud colleagues, shape our CI/CD pipelines, and help improve how we build and deploy as we grow. It’s a hands-on role for someone who likes variety and wants to see their work running in real shipments. 📍 Location: We need you to be within commutable distance to Basel given the role requires 50%+ time spent on-site. Founded in Switzerland in 2012, SkyCell is transforming global pharmaceutical supply chains through a combination of advanced temperature-controlled containers, IoT connectivity, and digital solutions. Our integrated product ecosystem helps leading pharmaceutical companies reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and ensure the safe delivery of life-saving medicines worldwide. Today, SkyCell operates at the intersection of hardware, software, data, and logistics - combining Swiss engineering excellence with a growing digital platform to shape the future of connected pharma supply chains. Why SkyCell? 🌱 Purpose-Driven Work: Make a real difference by contributing to a more sustainable future in global logistics and healthcare. 🚀 Innovation at Heart: Work with cutting-edge technology and be at the forefront of supply chain innovation. 🌎 Stronger together: Join a supportive team of talented individuals from over 40 countries, where we work together every step of the way. 💡 Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in our people – continuous learning and development are key pillars of SkyCell. 🏆 Award-Winning Culture: Join a workplace recognized for its commitment to excellence with a ‘Great Place to work’ award, as well as a Platinum Ecovadis rating highlighting our sustainability and employee well-being. What You'll Do: Design and implement embedded firmware for low-power IoT devices using C/C++ (RTOS or bare-metal) Integrate wireless communication technologies such as BLE, LoRa or Cellular Design, build and operate cloud-side ingestion pipelines and device fleet management systems for large-scale IoT deployments Contribute to the design and deployment of cloud architectures for IoT integrations Implement secure and reliable OTA update mechanisms for remote firmware management Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for firmware and cloud components (e.g. GitHub Actions) Collaborate with colleagues across firmware, hardware and cloud teams Troubleshoot complex system-level issues across device, connectivity and cloud layers Contribute to architecture and process improvements based on emerging best practices What You'll Bring: Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience Experience developing embedded firmware in C/C++ (RTOS or bare-metal), with a good understanding of common interfaces (I2C, SPI, UART) Experience with wireless protocols (BLE, LoRa or Cellular) and IoT communication protocols and data formats (MQTT, HTTP/REST, CoAP, Protobuf, JSON) Experience designing and operating cloud-based ingestion and device fleet management systems for connected IoT devices at scale Experience implementing OTA updates in production systems Proficiency in a backend language (e.g. Python, Go, Node.js or Java) for device integration, automation and diagnostics, with excellent system-level debugging and problem-solving skills Good written and spoken German and English If you don't meet every requirement but bring relevant experience and skills, we'd still like to hear from you. What's In It For You? ⚡ Flexibility & Balance: Flexible working hours and work-life balance allow you to tailor work to fit your life. 🌟 Recognition & Growth: Opportunities for career advancement in a company that values your contributions. 🌍 Flexible ways of working: Our global teams work across our offices in Zurich, Zug, Hyderabad and Basel, with a mix of on-site, hybrid and remote working. Role-specific locations and working arrangements are detailed above. 🎉 Company-wide Events: Join us for company events to celebrate successes, build teams, and share our vision. Plus, new joiners experience SkyWeek, our immersive onboarding program. 👶 Generous Maternity & Paternity Leave: Support for new parents with competitive maternity and paternity leave. 🏖️ Annual Leave & Bank Holidays: Enjoy a generous annual leave package, plus local bank holidays to recharge and unwind. title: Computational Scientist / Scientific Machine Learning
description: Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation, and control stack for the fusion energy reactors of the future. Spun out of EPFL’s Swiss Plasma Center and backed by top investors, our technology enables reliable operation, real-time monitoring, and analysis of high-temperature plasmas in fusion devices. We are founded by world-class experts at the intersection of fusion physics, advanced control, and AI (ex-Google DeepMind, EPFL). We are assembling a founding engineering team in Lausanne to build our core technology platform. We are looking for a Computational Scientist specialized in Scientific Machine Learning (SciML) to join our team. This job is for you if you know how to write numerical solvers that are fast, correct and differentiable end to end, and want to see them run against real plasma data and inside real control systems. We are looking for a PhD-level or senior computational researcher for this role. Responsibilities Design, implement and validate differentiable solvers in JAX for plasma physics problems such as free-boundary equilibrium, transport and state estimation. Make them robust and fast enough for production use via advanced numerical techniques for differential equation time stepping, as well as optimization of GPU/TPU performance. Using automatic differentiation for model calibration against experimental data, parameter estimation and controller design and optimization, working with our data and control engineers. Code ownership: quality, testing, verification against reference solutions, packaging and documentation. Requirements Substantial code written in a differentiable framework. Our stack is in JAX, Julia or PyTorch experts are very welcome if they’re happy to switch. Strong background in numerical methods for ODEs and PDEs: discretisation, stiff and implicit solvers, nonlinear and sparse linear solvers. Demonstrated ability to operate at the frontier of SciML, Universal Differential Equations, Neural ODEs, and other emerging hybrid data-driven/mechanistic paradigms. Evidence of independent work at the highest level: a PhD or thesis, published code that is used by others, or an industry project you owned. Experience in the following fields an advantage but not strictly required: The JAX ecosystem: Diffrax, Equinox, Optax, Lineax. Plasma, fluid, electromagnetic, or other multiphysics simulation. Having led the design of a scientific codebase used by others. What we offer Play a key role at a dynamic, fast-growing startup, shaping the technical solutions and products from the ground up. Build cutting-edge technology to monitor and control plasmas in real fusion devices, working side-by-side with leading plasma and control experts. Great working conditions, located in Lausanne, Switzerland, a city and country known for its high quality of life. description: Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation, and control stack for the fusion energy reactors of the future. title: Senior Data Scientist, Trust & Safety
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

You’ll join Trust & Safety’s Actioning team, whose mission is to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. The team owns critical mechanisms, including user reporting, moderation workflows, policy enforcement, and interventions against malicious users.

You will leverage your expertise in machine learning to research, design and implement new models for report and appeals prioritization, advanced sanctioning based on users' suspicions, and automation of moderation decisions. This involves working closely with our engineering teams to develop robust pipelines for data handling, feature engineering, model training, deployment, and continuous improvement. 

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will utilize advanced machine learning techniques to analyze text, images, and other data formats, tackling complex challenges to identify and address content that poses potential risks. You will champion best practices and methodologies, significantly enhancing the team's effectiveness and safeguarding Vinted. You will mentor others, influence the strategic direction for model development, and facilitate cross-functional collaborations to drive impactful results.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Lead the research, development, and end-to-end lifecycle of production machine learning models that prioritize and automate actions on harmful marketplace entities at scale.
  • Play a crucial role in establishing and refining essential machine learning processes, such as data versioning, creating labeling pipelines, and ensuring high-quality data availability for effective model training.
  • Actively collaborate across teams, particularly with Data Infrastructure and backend engineers, to develop and maintain scalable data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring optimal performance and scalability of deployed models.
  • Influence and contribute to the strategic roadmap for the Actioning team, collaborating with Decision Scientists to test, assess, and continuously improve new models.

About you 

  • Proven track record in data science (4+ years of experience), with a strong foundation in machine learning, statistics, or computational mathematics.
  • Proficiency in both classical and deep learning techniques, and an adeptness in leveraging the latest tools and methodologies to solve complex problems.
  • Hands-on experience building and deploying agentic AI applications or LLM-powered workflows that handle large traffic, balancing quality, latency, and cost efficiency.
  • Deep understanding of the challenges involved in deploying, maintaining, and scaling real-time ML models in production, with a proven ability to address these challenges effectively.
  • Proven capability to work with engineering teams, designing and implementing efficient data ingestion, feature engineering, and model training pipelines that support robust and reliable model deployment.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities, with a commitment to staying at the forefront of developments in machine learning and data science, driving innovation and thought leadership within the team.
  • Ability to clearly communicate complex ideas and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring that technical elements are properly understood and integrated to deliver business value.
  • Past experience with fraud detection, harmful content detection or any other adversarial domain would be considered an advantage. 

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture

title: Studio Director
description:
As Studio Director, you will lead the end-to-end operation of Suitsupply's photo studio, ensuring the efficient delivery of high-quality visual assets across every customer touchpoint. You will drive operational excellence through process optimization, resource planning, and technology enablement, partnering closely with Creative, Brand, Merchandising, Marketing, E-Commerce, and Production teams. This role calls for a strong operational mindset, balancing quality, speed, cost, and capacity while identifying opportunities to simplify processes and increase productivity. You will own the studio's technology roadmap, including AI-driven solutions, and lead a cross-functional network of photographers, stylists, retouchers, and producers. Your leadership will directly shape the scalability, efficiency, and creative output of one of Suitsupply's core content production functions. 
What You Will Do 
  • Lead day-to-day studio operations — managing capacity, resource allocation, schedules, and workload planning — and ensure output is delivered on time, on budget, and to quality standards. 
  • Coordinate photographers, stylists, retouchers, and producers, and establish KPIs and reporting to track throughput, turnaround, utilization, and quality. 
  • Own and continuously improve end-to-end studio workflows, using production data and bottleneck analysis to eliminate inefficiencies and drive scalable ways of working. 
  • Evaluate, implement, and optimize technologies for production planning, asset management, and workflow automation, leveraging AI to accelerate content production and improve quality control. 
  • Build business cases for technology investments and drive adoption across the studio team, partnering with Technology and Digital teams. 
  • Serve as the primary operational point of contact for studio matters across Creative, Brand, Marketing, Merchandising, Retail, E-commerce, and Production teams. 
  • Manage external partners — retouching, production, equipment, and technology vendors — negotiating contracts and rates to ensure cost-effective, high-quality service. 
  • Own the studio operating budget across external retouching, tooling, technology, equipment, and resources, monitoring productivity, utilization, and costs to optimize spend. 
  • Support strategic planning and future studio capability development. 
Who You Are 
  • 10+ years in studio operations, content production, or related operational leadership, with proven experience managing high-volume production in fashion, retail, e-commerce, or a comparable industry. 
  • Strong operational and analytical mindset, using data and metrics to improve workflows, simplify processes, and drive efficiency. 
  • Experience implementing new technologies, workflow management systems, and AI-enabled solutions; hands-on with platforms such as Creative Force, Photoshop, and Figma. 
  • Strong project, stakeholder, and resource management skills across competing priorities and deadlines. 
  • Commercially minded, with experience managing budgets, vendors, and operational performance. 
  • Self-directed, pragmatic, and solution-oriented, with strong ownership and accountability. 
  • Bachelor's degree in Photography, Creative Production, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred. 
What You Will Get 
  • Autonomy: We empower you to take ownership, make meaningful decisions, and drive impact without layers of sign-off. 
  • Growth: We see your potential as a key asset. At Suitsupply, you'll have abundant opportunities to learn, grow, and excel in a supportive environment that encourages development at every step. 
  • Corporate Social Responsibility: Our commitment to sustainability and ethical business is unwavering. We work exclusively with suppliers who uphold the highest standards, in alignment with the International Labour Organization. 
  • Style: Immerse yourself in a world of beautifully crafted, high-quality products, and enjoy a 40% discount on Suitsupply products.
  • Compensation: We offer a competitive salary of based on relevant skills and experience.

Kortom, wil je meer strategisch adviseren, collega’s coachen en écht impact maken binnen een snelgroeiende internationale SaaS-organisatie? Dan maken wij graag kennis met je. Jouw rol Als Senior Implementatie Consultant word je verantwoordelijk voor meerdere implementaties bij verschillende organisaties, met een diversiteit aan Whitevision producten. Jij bent het aanspreekpunt en de trusted advisor voor jouw klanten. Je bepaalt grotendeels zelf, in overleg met de klant, waar je je werkzaamheden uitvoert. Je analyseert klantprocessen, denkt strategisch mee over de beste inrichting en begeleidt organisaties servicegericht naar een succesvolle livegang. Je werkt zelfstandig, deelt je kennis met het team en coacht startende consultants. Je signaleert commerciële kansen bij bestaande klanten en draagt bij aan standaardisatie en verbetering van onze consultancyprocessen, die het team als geheel beter maken bijvoorbeeld door het inzetten van AI gedreven functionaliteit. Tegelijk blijf je jezelf ontwikkelen: je vergroot je productkennis, houdt je vakkennis bij en krijgt de ruimte om door te groeien richting een leidinggevende, coachende of expertrol binnen onze consultancyorganisatie. Je taken en verantwoordelijkheden zijn: + Je leidt end to end de implementatietrajecten. + Je analyseert documentprocessen en vertaalt deze naar slimme, schaalbare oplossingen. + Je adviseert klanten op operationeel én managementniveau. + Je traint eindgebruikers en zorgt voor maximale adoptie van onze software. + Je bewaakt planning, kwaliteit en klanttevredenheid binnen je projecten. + Je coacht junior en medior consultants en deelt actief je kennis. Wat breng je mee? + Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde Hbo, bijvoorbeeld richting BIM, Bedrijfskunde of bedrijfseconomie. + Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het uitvoeren van software-implementaties. + Je hebt al ervaring met projectleiding en stakeholdermanagement. + Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden (Nederlands én Engels). + Analytisch, resultaatgericht en commercieel bewust. + Ervaring met SaaS-oplossingen, SQL, ERP en affiniteit met documentverwerking is een pré. + Een coachende instelling: je vindt het leuk om collega’s verder te helpen. + Je bent minimaal 32 uur per week beschikbaar (onze voorkeur gaat uit naar 40 uur). Jij bent de consultant waar klanten om vragen en waar collega’s van leren. Bij Whitevision krijg je de ruimte, het vertrouwen en de schaal van een groeiende Europese groep om écht impact te maken. Wat bieden wij? Naast het werken binnen een gezellig, gemotiveerd en betrokken team bieden wij jou: + Een salaris tussen €4.250 en €6.000 (o.b.v. 40 uur), afhankelijk van je opleiding en ervaring. + Een auto van de zaak, laptop, mobiele telefoon en pensioenregeling. + 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om 5 extra dagen te kopen (o.b.v. 40 uur). + Een inspirerende werkomgeving met flexibiliteit in locatie/werkplek (hybride) en werktijden. + Verantwoordelijkheid en zelfstandigheid in je rol, met invloed op onze diensten en strategie. + Een professioneel en hardwerkend team, waar samenwerken en ontspanning samen gaan. + Een informele organisatie waar we regelmatig uitjes organiseren met het team en bedrijf Over Whitevision Whitevision is een toonaangevende SaaS-speler in Intelligent Document Processing & Management, die meer dan 2300 organisaties helpt hun documentprocessen slimmer, sneller en betrouwbaarder te maken. Wij ontwikkelen slimme, schaalbare en betrouwbare tools voor factuurverwerking, procurement, spend en document management, die naadloos integreren met een breed scala aan ERP-systemen. Vandaag de dag vertrouwen onze klanten op onze oplossingen. Vanuit kantoren in Breda, Rotterdam, Zoetermeer, De Goorn, Milton Keynes en Southampton werken ruim 140 medewerkers aan de doorontwikkeling en toepassing ervan, in een cultuur gebouwd op de kernwaarden betrokken, ambitieus, respectvol en daadkrachtig. Als Senior Implementatie Consultant speel je een sleutelrol: jij zorgt ervoor dat onze klanten succesvol live gaan én tevreden blijven. Je werkt nauw samen met 45 gedreven collega’s in het Support & Consultancy team. In een omgeving waar je je productkennis verder verdiept en je expertise volop kunt inzetten en uitbouwen. Doorgroeimogelijkheden Binnen Whitevision krijg je de ruimte om door te groeien naar rollen met meer strategische, organisatorische en internationale impact. Afhankelijk van jouw ambities kun je je ontwikkelen richting meer inhoudelijke diepgang (solution expert) of juist breder leiderschap als Lead of Manager binnen onze snelgroeiende internationale organisatie. title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

Overview

We are looking for an exceptional full-stack software engineer who will act as a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to serve as the critical interface between the central AI Application Modernization Factory and our application teams. The FDE will be temporarily embedded within delivery teams to directly drive the modernization of key applications, ensuring technical success, accelerated adoption of AI-assisted SDLC practices, and lasting upskilling of team members. This is a high-impact, hybrid role requiring advanced software engineering skills, deep knowledge of cloud-native patterns, and proven expertise in consultation, change management, and building strong rapport with diverse teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Application Modernization Execution: Embed with application teams to provide hands-on technical leadership, driving the design, development, and delivery of modernization efforts (re-platforming, microservices adoption) to AWS cloud-native architectures.
  • AI-First SDLC Adoption & Upskilling: Act as the subject matter expert on the AI Modernization Factory's tools and processes (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code). Drive the adoption and change management necessary to embed AI-assisted software development practices into the team’s daily workflow.
  • Consultative Engineering & Change Management: Build trust and rapport with new, diverse teams quickly. Identify team-specific technical and process bottlenecks, recommending and implementing solutions, and effectively managing the people/process side of technical change.
  • Hands-on Software Development: Make significant code contributions, focusing on setting up architectural scaffolding, CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Terraform), and solving complex, blocking integration challenges for the embedded team.
  • Feedback Loop: Serve as the primary feedback channel, relaying practical challenges, tool deficiencies, and necessary process adjustments back to the central Principal Engineer and Architect to continuously improve the factory's capabilities.
  • Standards & Quality: Ensure embedded teams adhere to the central factory's engineering standards, including Twelve-Factor App principles, DevSecOps practices, and high-quality coding standards.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: 5+ years of progressive experience in Software Engineering, with a focus on enterprise applications and application modernization.
  • Full Stack Proficiency: Strong hands-on experience across the full application stack (front-end, back-end, database, infrastructure). Expert proficiency in one or more modern technology languages (e.g., Python, TypeScript, C#, Java).
  • Cloud Native & IaC: Deep practical experience building and deploying scalable applications on AWS. Strong proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), specifically Terraform.
  • Consulting & Change Management: Proven ability to onboard rapidly, assess team dynamics and technical landscapes, influence technical direction without formal authority, and drive organizational/process change within established engineering teams.
  • DevSecOps & CI/CD: Hands-on mastery of setting up and optimizing CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and integrating DevSecOps best practices.
  • Architectural Understanding: Solid understanding of modern architectural patterns (microservices, serverless, event-driven architecture) and the principles of Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Exceptional communication, presentation, and listening skills. Ability to articulate complex technical issues and solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders effectively.

Preferred Skills (A Plus)

  • Prior experience in a consulting, Staff Engineer, or Forward Deployed role, specifically focused on technical adoption or modernization.
  • Direct experience training or mentoring other software engineers in new technologies or methodologies.
  • Hands-on experience with modern UI frameworks like React, NextJS, or similar.
  • Experience utilizing AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code) in a professional development environment.
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) and serverless architectures (AWS Lambda).

As a collective, our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions. Together, we unite for equality and equity. Banyan is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of any protected characteristic, including race, color, genetic information, creed, national origin, religion, sex, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, lawful alien status, ancestry, age, marital status, or protected veteran status and will not discriminate against anyone on the basis of a disability. We support an inclusive workplace where associates excel based on personal merit, qualifications, experience, ability, and job performance.

All candidates must apply through our official Careers site to be considered for employment. Applications submitted outside of our applicant tracking system will not be reviewed.

Banyan Software may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and/or assessing applicants during the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our team.
